duka.title: Duka Quick Start Guide
duka.description: Set up a branch, add products and make your first sale
duka.content:
# Duka Quick Start Guide

Duka by Base is the point of sale (POS) and inventory module. It handles orders, payments, stock, customers, staff and day-to-day reporting for every branch.

## Before you start
Duka must be switched on in **Discover**. The sidebar then shows **Dashboard, POS/Tables, Orders, Services, Inventory, Crew, Customers, Reports, Documents, E-Signature, Petty Cash, Refunds** and the setup pages (Categories, Tables, Suppliers). What you see depends on your role.

## 1. Create your branch
1. Open **Branch Management** in the admin menu.
2. Click **New Branch**, enter the **Branch Name** and **Location**.
3. Choose the **POS Mode**:
   - **Duka Services**: restaurants, cafes and service businesses (tables, kitchen, services).
   - **Retail**: shops that sell products at a counter (no tables).
   - **Hospital**: departments, medications and services, with patients instead of customers.
   - **Hotel**: rooms and floors with check-in/check-out.

## 2. Set up categories
Open **Categories**. Create a **Main Category** (and tick **Show on POS** so it appears at the till), then **Sub-Categories** under it. Add **Modifiers** (add-ons) if you sell customisable items.

## 3. Add products and services
- **Inventory** holds products you stock and count.
- **Services** (restaurant, hospital and hotel modes) hold items you sell that may use stock through a formula.
- Use **Bulk Import** to load many items from Excel.

## 4. Payment methods
Add Cash, M-Pesa, Card, Bank and any others in **Payment Methods**. See *Payment Methods* under Account & Billing.

## 5. Tables (restaurants)
In **Tables** create locations (for example Main Hall, Patio) and add the tables in each.

## 6. Add staff
Add cashiers, waiters and managers in **Crew Management** and give each the right role.

## Making a sale
**Retail:** search or scan products, add to cart, apply a discount if needed, choose a payment method, complete the sale and print the receipt.

**Restaurant:** pick a table, add items (with notes and add-ons), send to the kitchen, add more items as needed, then settle the bill and free the table.

See *Taking Orders at the POS* and *Taking Payments* for the details.

## Every day
- Check the **Dashboard** for sales, orders and low-stock alerts.
- Watch the **Offline** indicator at the top of the POS if the connection is poor.
- Review **Reports** and **Orders** at close of day.

duka.title: Managing Tables & Dining Areas
duka.description: Create locations and tables, then run the floor from the Tables screen
duka.content:
# Managing Tables & Dining Areas

Tables apply to restaurant-style branches. They have two parts: **setting them up** (admin) and **running them** (daily).

## Set up locations and tables
Open **Tables** under the setup menu (**Table Settings**).
1. Add a **Table Location** such as *Main Hall*, *Outdoor* or *VIP*.
2. Add the individual **Tables** inside each location.
3. Use **Edit** to rename, and **Enable / Disable** to hide a table or a whole location from the POS without deleting it.
   - Disabling a location hides all its tables from the POS. Enabling it brings them back.
4. Delete only if the table or location is no longer needed.

The settings list also shows each table's **Occupancy**, **Amount** and **Served By**.

## Run the floor
The **Tables** screen (the POS home in restaurant mode) shows every table by location and status:
- **Available**: free to seat.
- **Occupied**: has an open order.
- **Locked**: being served by another staff member.
- **Unassigned**: no server assigned yet.

Open a table to add items. If a table is "being served by another staff member", you cannot open it until it is released.

## Table statistics and filters
The **Table Stats** panel shows how many tables are occupied or available, and the open amount. Filter by location, server, or **With balance only** to find tables that still owe money.

## Bulk actions for managers
Select several tables to:
- **Pay All**: confirm payment for the open tables in one go (choose the payment method).
- **Void All**: remove every item from those carts and free the tables.
- **Clear All**: empty the selected tables.

These are powerful, so keep them limited to managers through permissions.

## Slots and staff slots
**Slots Management** lets you create **Staff Slots** and quickly add tables to the active slot (**Quick Add Table**). Select a slot to see the customer tables inside it.

duka.title: Inventory & Stock Management
duka.description: Add items, track stock, import from Excel and keep levels healthy
duka.content:
# Inventory & Stock Management

Open **Inventory** to see **Product Inventory**: stock levels, pricing and status for every item in the branch.

## Stock states
Each item shows a state at a glance:
- **In stock**
- **Almost out** (low stock)
- **Out of stock**

Use the **Stock State** filter or the **Low Stock** view to see what needs reordering. Items with variants show **Variant stock** per variant.

## Add items
- Add an item manually with its code, name, unit, price and starting stock.
- Use **Bulk Import** (Excel). Download the template, fill it in, map columns and import. You can update existing items instead of creating duplicates. See *Data Import Guide*.
- **Units of Measure** are created automatically on import when missing, or manage them from the inventory settings.

## Search, filter and manage
- Search by **name** or **code**.
- Select several rows to **Delete Selected**.
- **Delete ALL inventory items** wipes every item for the shop and cannot be undone, so use it with care.
- **Export** the list to **Excel** or **PDF**.

## Purchasing and moving stock
Inside inventory settings you will also find:
- **Purchase Orders** (see *Supplier Management & Purchase Orders*).
- **Material Transfers** between branches or locations (see below).
- **Deliveries** from suppliers and to customers (see *Delivery Management*).
- **Top Sellers Report**.

### Material transfers
1. Create a transfer with the transfer type, route (from and to), transfer date and expected delivery.
2. Add the products and quantities.
3. A manager **Approves** (or **Rejects** with a reason) the transfer.
4. When the goods arrive, **Mark Complete**. Stock updates at both ends.
5. You can **Print** the transfer and **Cancel** or **Delete** it if needed.

## Services that use stock
In **Services**, a service can be linked to inventory through a **Formula** (for example a dish that uses certain ingredients). When you **Activate** a service, selling it deducts the linked stock. **Deactivate** stops deductions.

## Keep stock accurate
- Receive deliveries the day they arrive.
- Do regular counts and correct differences.
- Review the **Inventory** reports and the stock value on the dashboard each week.

duka.title: Delivery Management
duka.description: Record deliveries from suppliers and to customers, and share delivery notes
duka.content:
# Delivery Management

Deliveries record goods moving **in** (from suppliers) and **out** (to customers). You find them in the inventory settings under **Deliveries**.

## Two kinds of delivery
- **Supplier Deliveries**: goods received from a supplier.
- **Customer Deliveries**: goods delivered to a customer.

The list shows each delivery's **Delivery Code**, **direction**, counterparty, items, total value, status, who delivered and who received.

## Record a delivery
1. Click to add a delivery and choose supplier or customer.
2. Pick the counterparty (the supplier or customer).
3. Add the **items**: item, unit, quantity and unit price.
4. Enter **Delivered by** and **Received by**.
5. Save. The status shows **Pending** until it is delivered.

## Track and search
- Search by delivery code, deliverer or receiver.
- The totals at the top show **Total**, **Delivered** and **Pending**.
- Open a delivery to see its **Delivery Items** and **Delivery Note**.

## Delivery notes
From a delivery you can:
- **Print Note** or **Print / Save PDF**.
- **Send Note** by email: enter the recipient email and name, an optional CC and a personal message.

## Reports and exports
- **Delivery Rate Report** shows how reliably deliveries are completed.
- **Export Excel / Export PDF** from the deliveries list.

## Tips
- Receive supplier deliveries the same day so stock stays accurate.
- Use the delivery code as the reference when you reconcile supplier bills.

duka.title: Product Modifiers & Add-ons
duka.description: Let customers customise items with extras and options
duka.content:
# Product Modifiers & Add-ons

Modifiers (add-ons) let you sell variations such as extra toppings, sizes or sides.

## Where to manage them
Open **Categories** (**Category Main Settings**). It has three tabs:
- **Main Category**
- **Sub-Category**
- **Modifiers**

## Create a modifier
1. Open the **Modifiers** tab.
2. Add a **Modifier Name** (for example *Extra cheese*, *Large*, *No ice*).
3. Save. The list shows who created it and when.
4. Use **Edit** to rename it, or **Delete** (with confirmation) when it is no longer used.

## Attach to products
When you create or edit a service, pick the add-ons that apply in the **Addons (optional)** field. Only attached modifiers are offered at the till.

## Use at the POS
When you add an item that has add-ons, the **Product Addons** window opens:
- Select the add-ons the customer wants.
- If add-ons are required, at least one must be selected before you continue.
- Add a **note** for anything else (for example *well done*).
- Use **View addons** on a cart line to review or edit them later.

## Tips
- Keep modifier names short and clear for fast ordering.
- Review old modifiers each season and delete the ones you no longer use.

duka.title: Supplier Management & Purchase Orders
duka.description: Keep your supplier list and create purchase orders
duka.content:
# Supplier Management & Purchase Orders

## Suppliers
Open **Suppliers** (**Supplier Main Settings**).
1. Click to add a supplier.
2. Enter the **Supplier name**, **Phone** and **Email**.
3. Save. Use **Edit** to change details, or **Delete** with confirmation.

Suppliers are used on purchase orders, deliveries, supplier bills in Pesa and the supplier statement reports.

## Purchase orders
Open **Purchase Orders** in the inventory settings and click **New PO**.
1. **Basic Info:** choose the order type. A purchase order uses a **Supplier**, a sales order uses a **Customer**. Set the **Expected Delivery Date** and notes.
2. **Order Items:** select the inventory item, unit, quantity and price. Add notes per item and use **Add Another Item** for more lines. The **Running Total** updates as you go.
3. **Review & submit:** check everything and confirm.

## Receiving goods
When goods arrive, record the delivery (see *Delivery Management*) so stock increases. For supplier invoices, create a **Supplier Bill** in Pesa and pay it from there.

## Tips
- Keep supplier phone and email current so delivery notes can be shared.
- Match each delivery to its purchase order before paying the bill.

duka.title: Crew, Shifts & Clock-in
duka.description: Staff schedules, attendance, clock-in and leave in one place
duka.content:
# Crew, Shifts & Clock-in

The **Crew** page is where staff see their schedule, attendance and leave. Managers use it to plan the roster.

## Tabs
- **Shifts**: the **Staff Schedule**, showing who works when. Filter by **Morning**, **Afternoon** or **Evening**, and **Export PDF**.
- **My Leave**: your leave balance and requests (see *Leave Management*).
- **Attendance**: your history with **Present**, **Late**, **Absent** and **On Leave**, total hours and attendance rate for the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
- **Payroll**: coming soon on this page. Payslips are in the Bandu module.

The HR features need **Bandu by Base** to be enabled in **Discover**.

## Create and edit shifts
Managers add shifts for employees from the schedule. If an employee has none, it shows **No shift assigned**. Use **Delete Shift** (with confirmation) to remove one.

## Clock in and out
Staff can clock in from the **Clock In** screen: *Clock In to Start Your Day or Clock Out to End Your Day*. Admins can also share a **Staff Clock-In link and QR code**, so staff scan the QR on their phone (see *Attendance & Clock-in*). Biometric devices can sync attendance too.

## Reports
- **Attendance** shows daily presence, late arrivals and hours.
- Export the schedule or attendance to PDF or Excel for payroll checks.

## Tips
- Publish the schedule a week ahead.
- Review late arrivals weekly and address them early.
- Make sure every user has an employee record so attendance links to payroll.

duka.title: Taking Orders at the POS
duka.description: Add items, notes, add-ons and discounts, then send or close the order
duka.content:
# Taking Orders at the POS

## Start an order
- **Restaurant:** open a table from the Tables screen.
- **Retail:** use the POS screen directly (or a quick-checkout slot).
- **Hotel:** use the Rooms view; **Hospital:** pick a department.

## Find and add items
- Browse by **category**, or use **Search items** at the top.
- **Barcode scanning:** tap the scanner to use a scan gun, type the barcode and press Enter, or scan with the device camera. The item is added automatically.
- Tapping an item adds it to the cart. Tap the quantity to change it; decimals are supported (for example 0.5 kg).

## Customise a line
- **Notes**: add instructions such as *extra spicy* or *no onions*.
- **Add-ons**: if the item has modifiers, choose the add-ons. At least one add-on must be selected when the item requires it.
- **Custom Item**: add an item that is not in the catalogue by entering the name, main category, price and quantity.

## The cart summary
The cart shows **Subtotal**, **Discount** and **Amount Due**, plus **Served by**. You can:
- Link a **customer** to the order (remove them and it continues as a walk-in).
- Apply a **discount**.
- **Clear Cart** to start again, or **Close Order** to finish with confirmation.

## Kitchen and sent items
In restaurants, send items to the kitchen. After an item is sent, only a **cashier or admin** can reduce its quantity, to prevent loss.

## Staff earnings and deductions
- **Configure Earnings** lets you assign staff members and their share of the order (for example for commission). The total cannot exceed the order value.
- For services linked to stock, **Inventory Deductions** shows what will be removed from stock. You can adjust the sold variant.

## Hotel check-in
For hotel orders you can **resend the hotel check-in information** to the guest.

## When you finish
Go to payment (see *Taking Payments*). Receipts and bills can be printed through the browser or the Print Agent (see *Printing Setup*).

duka.title: Taking Payments
duka.description: Cash, M-Pesa STK Push, split payments, subscription visits and voiding
duka.content:
# Taking Payments

## The payment screen
After you open the payment drawer you see the **Order Summary** (Subtotal, Discount, Amount Due), the **Customer**, and your **Payment Method** choices.

## Cash and other methods
1. Choose the **Payment Method** (Cash, Card, Bank, Cheque and so on, as set up in Payment Methods).
2. Confirm the amount.
3. Complete the payment. The order closes and you can print the receipt.

## M-Pesa STK Push
1. Choose **M-Pesa**.
2. Enter the customer's number in Kenyan format, for example 0712345678. Add the customer name and email if you want them saved.
3. Click **Send STK Push**.
4. The screen shows **Check Your Phone** while the customer enters their M-Pesa PIN.
5. When the payment is **Confirmed**, the sale completes.

If the customer changes their mind, **Cancel Payment** or **Cancel & Retry**. If the payment status is unknown, check the order's payment record before charging again.

## Pay with a subscription or package
If the order's customer has an active subscription package:
- Choose **Use Subscription Visit** to deduct one prepaid visit from the package. The order amount becomes zero.
- The screen shows the visits remaining and warns when the package is **running low**.
- Choose **Pay Normally** to charge the customer instead.

## Voiding a bill
Use **Void Bill** (with confirmation) when an order should be cancelled. Voiding is tracked, and may need permission depending on your role.

## Paying several tables at once
Managers can select tables and use **Pay All** to confirm payment for each (see *Managing Tables & Dining Areas*).

## After payment
Print or send the receipt. If an order was created by mistake or goods were returned, see *Refunds*.

duka.title: Working Offline
duka.description: Keep selling when the internet drops; orders sync automatically
duka.content:
# Working Offline

Internet problems should not stop sales. When the connection drops, the POS keeps working.

## How you know
The POS header shows an **Offline** badge. A counter shows how many **offline orders** are waiting to sync.

## What happens
- Orders you complete while offline are **saved on the device**.
- When the connection returns, they are **sent automatically** to the server.
- The counter drops as each order syncs.

## Good habits
- Keep the device and browser open until the counter reaches zero.
- Avoid clearing browser data while orders are pending.
- Don't use a different device for the same order while offline.
- For actions that need the server (live M-Pesa STK Push, reports, e-invoice verification) wait until you are back online.

## If an order fails to sync
Failed orders stay in the queue with an error. Reconnect and refresh the page; if it persists, contact support with the order number.

duka.title: Refunds
duka.description: Record, approve and process refunds and exchanges
duka.content:
# Refunds

Use **Refunds** to record returned goods or money given back to a customer. Each refund moves through approval before it is processed.

## Refund statuses
**Pending**, **Approved**, **Processed** and **Voided**.

## Create a refund
1. Open **Refunds** and click **New Refund**.
2. Choose the **Refund Date** and the **Original Invoice**. The invoice number, customer and contact details fill in automatically.
3. Pick the **Refund Type**: **Full**, **Partial** or **Exchange**.
4. Choose the **Refund Reason**: Defective, Wrong Item, Damaged, Customer Dissatisfaction or Return Policy, and add detail.
5. Choose the **Refund Method**: M-Pesa, Bank Transfer, Cheque, Store Credit or Original Method.
6. **Add Refund Items**: pick from **Inventory Items**, **Services** or create a **Custom Item**, and set quantity and unit price.
7. Add notes and save. The total refund amount is calculated.

## Approve and process
- A manager opens the refund and clicks **Approve** (or voids it with a reason).
- Once approved, **Process** completes it.
- **Void** cancels a refund and needs a **reason**.

## Find and review
- Filters: **Date Range**, **type**, **method**, **reason** and search.
- Summary cards show **Total Refunds**, **Total Refund Amount**, **Pending Refunds** and **Processed Refunds**.
- Open a refund for details and the **audit information** (who created and updated it).

## Tips
- Always link the refund to the original invoice.
- Use **Store Credit** to keep the money in the business.
- If the original invoice was submitted to KRA, create a **Credit Note** in Pesa as well (see *Credit & Debit Notes*).

duka.title: Petty Cash
duka.description: Track deposits, withdrawals and small expenses with approvals
duka.content:
# Petty Cash

**Petty Cash** records small cash movements so the float always balances.

## Overview cards
- **Current Balance**
- **Total Deposits**
- **Total Withdrawals**
- **Pending Transactions**

## Transaction types
- **Deposit**: money added to the petty cash.
- **Withdrawal**: money taken out.
- **Expense**: money spent, for example *Office Supplies*, *Transport*, *Utilities* or *Repairs*.

## Record a transaction
1. Click **New Transaction**.
2. Choose the **date**, **type** and **amount** (must be greater than zero).
3. Enter a **description** and **category**.
4. Choose the **payee**: a **Shop User** or a **Custom Payee**.
5. Choose the **payment method** (Cash, M-Pesa, Bank Transfer, Cheque).
6. Add a **receipt number**, **receipt date** and notes.

## Approval workflow
New transactions start as **Pending**. A manager opens one and clicks **Approve** to include it in the balance, or **Void** it (a reason is required). Voided entries stay on record for audit.

## Review
- Filter by **date range**, **type** and **category**, and search.
- Open any entry for full details and audit information.

## Tips
- Attach or note the receipt number for every expense.
- Reconcile the physical cash to the **Current Balance** at the end of each day.
- Limit approval permission to managers.

duka.title: Printing Setup (Receipts, Bills & Kitchen)
duka.description: Install the Print Agent, connect printers and control reprints
duka.content:
# Printing Setup (Receipts, Bills & Kitchen)

Base can print through the browser, or directly to receipt and kitchen printers using the **Print Agent**.

## Print methods
In **System Setup > Printer Management** you choose how printing works. **Browser** printing uses the normal print dialog. The **Print Agent** is recommended when you use several printers.

## Install the Print Agent
1. Open **System Setup > Printer Management**.
2. Click **Download BASE Print Agent** and run the installer for your operating system.
3. If your thermal printer needs one, install the **printer driver** first (use **Download Drivers**).
4. Install the agent on the computer that is connected to each printer.
5. The agent appears under **Connected Agents**, and its printers appear in the list with an **Online** status.

## Assign printers
- Choose a **Default Printer**.
- Use **Assign Category** to send a main category to a printer. For example drinks to the bar printer and food to the kitchen printer.
- Use **Test Print** to confirm each printer works.
- Windows tip: set the printer as the default in your operating-system print settings.

## Receipt appearance
Under **System Setup** you can adjust the **Receipt Print Appearance**: font size (Small, Normal, Large, X-Large) and text weight. The preview shows the effect, and settings save automatically shortly after you stop changing them.

## Warranty and receipt text
Set the **warranty text** and the first and second lines printed on receipts.

## Controls and reprints
In **Printing Controls**:
- Turn on **Enable Print Controls** to track printing.
- **Save document on every print** to keep a snapshot for audit.
- Set **Print Limits** (global or per document type).
- **Reprint Controls**: allow reprinting, require a reason, require admin approval.

## Troubleshooting
- Printer **Offline**: check the agent is running on that computer.
- Nothing prints: run **Test Print** and check the default printer.
- Wrong printer: review the **Assign Category** setting.

duka.title: Customers, Packages & Gift Cards
duka.description: Manage customers, subscription packages and gift cards
duka.content:
# Customers, Packages & Gift Cards

Open **Customers** (called **Patients** in hospital mode and **Clients** in Dala).

## Add a customer
Click **Add Customer** and fill in:
- **Entity Type**: Individual or Company.
- **Customer Name** (or Company Name and Contact Person), **Phone**, **Email**.
- **Address** (street, building, city, county, country).
- **Business Information**: customer type, **payment terms** (days), **credit limit**, and who they are **assigned to**.
- **KRA PIN** (format A123456789Z).

Email, address and KRA PIN are optional.

## Import customers
Use **Import** to upload an Excel file with column mapping (see *Data Import Guide*).

## Customer details
Open a customer to see **Details**, **Contact Info**, **Documents** (upload IDs, contracts, KRA certificates and more), **Engagement** (conversations, unreplied messages), **Orders** and **Visit History** with ratings and reviews.

## Packages and subscriptions
Depending on your business mode, the page also has tabs for:
- **Packages**: sell prepaid bundles.
- **Subscriptions**: track each customer's package, visits used and left, expiry and revenue. A filter shows **active subscriptions expiring within X days**.
- **Consultations / Appointments / Bookings**: for service businesses.

At the POS, a customer with an active package can **Use Subscription Visit** instead of paying.

## Gift cards
In the **Gift Cards** tab:
- **Issue Gift Card** to a customer, or **Create Gift Card for Non-Customer**.
- Enter the amount, recipient, email and expiry date.
- **Send Email** to deliver it, or **Preview** it first.
- Track status for customer and non-customer gift cards.

## Reports and loyalty
The customer view highlights **Top Customers by Spend** and **Award Candidates** (loyal customers worth rewarding).

duka.title: Appointments & Bookings
duka.description: Calendar, booking list, classes and booking analytics
duka.content:
# Appointments & Bookings

For salons, clinics, spas and any business that takes appointments, use the **Staff** booking pages. They are organised into tabs.

## Tabs
- **Calendar**: a day view of appointments by staff member and time slot.
- **Booking List**: every booking with filters and actions.
- **Classes**: scheduled sessions with **Time slot**, **Session type**, **Instructor** and **Slots remaining**.
- **Analytics**: booking performance.

## Make a booking
1. Click **Add Appointment**.
2. Choose the **date**, **time range**, **staff member** and the **service**.
3. Select the **table or room** if relevant.
4. Choose the **client**: **Existing Client** or **New Client**. For a **Group Booking**, select several customers and set the **maximum capacity**.
5. Add **special requests**, notes and a **reminder frequency**.
6. Save.

## Move appointments
On the calendar, **pick up** an appointment and **drop** it in a new time slot or onto another staff member. Use **Prev Day** and **Next Day** to move between dates.

## Booking statuses
Bookings can be **Pending**, **Confirmed**, **Completed**, **Cancelled** or **No Show**. Update the status from the booking list.

## Analytics
Pick **Last 7, 30 or 90 days** to see **Total Bookings**, **Today**, **Upcoming**, **Revenue**, **Booking Trends**, **Booking Types**, **Top Staff Performance**, **Peak Hours** and **Top Services**.

## Notifications
You get a notification when a new booking or appointment is created, and for out-of-stock or low-inventory alerts. Open **Notifications** to review them.

duka.title: Hotel & Hospital Modes
duka.description: How Duka adapts for hotels and hospitals
duka.content:
# Hotel & Hospital Modes

Choose **Hotel** or **Hospital** as the **POS Mode** when you create a branch in **Branch Management**. The labels and screens change to suit.

## Hotel mode
- The POS home becomes **Rooms**; **Inventory** is labelled **Store**.
- **Room Management**: add **Locations** (floors such as *Ground Floor*) and **Rooms** (such as *Room 101*).
- The Rooms view shows each room as **Occupied**, **Available** or **Not Occupied**, with **Occupancy** and **Revenue** totals. Search rooms by name.
- Add **Services** that can be charged to a room.
- Guests can receive their **hotel check-in information** from the order.

### Hotel settings
In **System Setup** you can configure: check-in and check-out times, WiFi details, room rules (smoking, pets, visitors, minimum age, ID and credit card required), amenities (breakfast, room service), facilities (parking, pool, gym, laundry, shuttle), housekeeping, deposit and cancellation policies, and late check-out fees.

## Hospital mode
- The POS home is a **department browser**: select a department, then browse its **medications and services**.
- **Inventory** is labelled **Pharmacy**; **Customers** are **Patients**.
- Search across items from the top bar.

## Billing
Orders in both modes use the same payment flow as other branches (see *Taking Payments*).

pesa.title: Pesa Accounting Overview
pesa.description: What Pesa covers and how your sales flow into the books
pesa.content:
# Pesa Accounting Overview

Pesa by Base is the accounting module. It works with Duka so your sales, payments and expenses reach the books without re-typing.

## The Pesa menu
| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Key financial figures for the period you choose |
| **Invoices** | Customer invoices, quotes and payments |
| **Sales Receipts** | Cash-sale receipts posted to the books |
| **Expenses** | Money spent, with VAT and approval |
| **Bills** | Supplier bills you owe |
| **Debit/Credit Notes** | Adjust invoices and bills |
| **Journal Entries** | Every accounting entry, manual or automatic |
| **Banking** | Import and categorise bank statements |
| **Bank Reconciliation** | Match the books to the bank |
| **Chart of Accounts** | The list of accounts |
| **Reports** | Financial statements and ageing |
| **Asset Register / Requests / Maintenance** | Fixed assets (needs the Asset Manager add-on) |
| **Customers, Suppliers, Payment Methods, System Setup** | Supporting setup |

## How transactions reach the books
Every financial event creates a **journal entry**. The **Source** column on Journal Entries shows where it came from:
POS Sale, POS Subscription, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Reconciliation, Bank Upload, Income, Expense, Payroll, Credit Note, Debit Note, Note Void, or Manual.

Duka sales and payments can sync automatically if you enable **Auto Sync** when you turn on Pesa in **Discover**.

## Get started
1. Seed or review the **Chart of Accounts**.
2. Set your **base currency** (see *Multi-Currency*).
3. Set up **VAT** under Settings (see *VAT Compliance & Reporting*).
4. Add **bank / cash accounts** in the chart of accounts.
5. Import bank statements and start reconciling.

## Month-end routine
1. Post all draft sales receipts, expenses and notes.
2. Reconcile each bank account.
3. Review journals for unbalanced or duplicate entries.
4. Run the **Trial Balance**, **Profit and Loss** and **Balance Sheet**.
5. Export reports and file VAT.

pesa.title: Managing Journal Entries
pesa.description: Create manual entries and fix duplicates or unbalanced journals
pesa.content:
# Managing Journal Entries

**Journal Entries** lists every accounting entry in your books.

## Reading the list
Each row shows **Entry No.**, date, description, reference, **Source**, total debit, total credit, status and fiscal period. Filter by **source** (POS Sale, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Expense, Payroll, Bank Upload, Manual and more) or by period (Today to Last Year, Last 30/90 Days) and search by entry number, description, reference or amount.

## Create a manual entry
1. Click **New Entry**.
2. Set the **Entry Date** and description. A reference is required: click **Generate** to create one.
3. Add lines. For each: **Account**, **Memo**, and a **Debit** or **Credit**.
4. The entry must be **balanced** (total debits equal total credits). The form shows when it is balanced.
5. Save as **Draft**, or tick **Post immediately (skip Draft)**.

## Post and void
- **Post Entry** moves a draft into the books.
- **Void Entry** creates a **reversal entry** and marks the original as voided. You must give a reason.

## Details
Open an entry to see lines, fiscal period, who created and posted it, the source document and any void reason.

## Fix problems
- **Duplicates**: the page can list duplicate entries so you can **Keep only** one and delete the others.
- **Unbalanced** entry: contact support if the app flags one; do not edit the books around it.
- **Fix Now** helps repair voided receipts that still have active entries.

## Good practice
- Prefer posting from the source (invoice, bill, receipt) instead of manual journals.
- Use manual entries for adjustments, accruals and corrections only, with clear descriptions.

pesa.title: Financial Reports Guide
pesa.description: Profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, ledgers and more
pesa.content:
# Financial Reports Guide

Open **Reports** in Pesa to run the accounting reports. Pick the **period** and, if you run several branches, a **branch** (or **All Branches**).

## Reports available
| Report | Use it to |
|---|---|
| **Profit and Loss** | See income, cost of goods sold, gross profit, operating expense and net profit |
| **Balance Sheet** | See assets, liabilities and equity at a date, with a balance check |
| **Trial Balance** | Check that debits equal credits across all accounts |
| **General Ledger** | See every entry by account |
| **Account Balances** | See opening, movement and closing balances |
| **VAT Report** | See VAT collected and VAT paid by source |
| **Cash Flow** | See opening cash, inflows, outflows and closing cash |
| **Customer Statement** | Show a customer's invoices, credit notes and payments |
| **Supplier Statement** | Show a supplier's bills and payments |
| **AR Aging** | See what customers owe, by age |
| **AP Aging** | See what you owe suppliers, by age |

## Date options
Choose This Month, Last Month, This Quarter, This Year, Last 3 Months, a **Financial Year**, or a custom range. Use **Compare** to run a period against a previous one (for example *End of Last Month* or *End of Last Year*). Statements can run on an **Accrual** basis.

## Export and share
- **Export** to CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or PDF, or **Print**.
- **Email Report** sends it to a recipient with a subject and note.

## Tips
- Run the **Trial Balance** first. If it doesn't balance, fix journals before relying on other reports.
- If the **Balance Sheet** says it is unbalanced, check for unposted or unbalanced entries.
- Statements for individual customers and suppliers are useful before follow-ups.

pesa.title: Accounts Receivable Management
pesa.description: Track what customers owe and collect it on time
pesa.content:
# Accounts Receivable Management

Accounts receivable (AR) is money customers owe you.

## Where it comes from
Unpaid or partly-paid **invoices**. Each invoice shows the **balance due**, **due date** and **days overdue**.

## Track it
- **Invoices** page: filter by status, customer and date to see who is overdue.
- **AR Aging** report: groups balances by age, by invoice date or due date, with totals and **Total AR Outstanding**.
- **Customer Statement**: a full history for one customer. Compare two customers or periods.
- **AR Outstanding by Customer**: a summary list.

## Collect
1. Send the customer their statement or invoice.
2. When they pay, open the invoice and click **Make Payment**.
3. Receipts are created automatically.

## Credit and terms
Set each customer's **payment terms** (days) and **credit limit** on their profile.

## Adjustments
Use **Credit Notes** for returns or discounts and **Debit Notes** for extra charges (see *Credit & Debit Notes*).

## Tips
- Review the aging report weekly.
- Follow up the day an invoice becomes overdue.
- Record payments the same day to keep balances accurate.

pesa.title: Accounts Payable Management
pesa.description: Record supplier bills, pay them and keep track of what you owe
pesa.content:
# Accounts Payable Management

Accounts payable (AP) is money you owe suppliers. In Pesa, use **Bills**.

## Create a supplier bill
1. Open **Bills** and click **Create Supplier Bill**.
2. Choose the supplier, **bill date** and **due date**.
3. Add **bill items** (description, quantity, unit price) and VAT.
4. Save.

The list shows **Total Bills** and **Outstanding**, and filters by Today, This Week, This Month and Last Month.

## Pay a bill
1. Open the bill and click **Record Payment**.
2. Choose the **payment method** (M-Pesa, bank or cash), the **payment account** and the **amount** (partial payments are allowed).
3. Enter the transaction code or cheque number as the reference.
4. Save. The **Amount Paid** and **Amount Due** update.

Statuses: **Draft**, **Pending**, **Partial**, **Paid**, **Overdue**, **Voided**, **Cancelled**.

## Adjustments
Debit and credit notes can be applied to a bill. They appear on the bill under *Applied Credit/Debit Notes*.

## Void
**Void Bill** reverses the journal entry. It needs a reason and cannot be undone.

## Reports
- **AP Aging** shows how late your payables are.
- **Supplier Statement** shows a supplier's bills and payments.

## Tips
- Record bills as they arrive.
- Pay by due date to protect supplier relationships.
- Compare each bill to the delivery note before paying.

pesa.title: Bank Reconciliation
pesa.description: Match your books to the bank statement, step by step
pesa.content:
# Bank Reconciliation

Reconciliation proves that your books agree with the bank for a given period.

## Start a session
1. Open **Bank Reconciliation** and click **Start Reconciling**.
2. Choose the **Bank / Cash Account**.
3. Enter the **Beginning balance** and **Statement ending balance** from your bank statement, plus the **Statement ending date**.
4. Add notes if needed and open the session.

The list shows **Recon. No.**, account, period, **Book Balance**, **Statement Balance**, **Difference**, number matched and status. Summary cards show **Open Sessions**, **In Progress** and **Completed**.

## In the workspace
The screen has two sides:
- **Bank Statement Lines**: lines from your statement (from an import, or added manually with **Add Lines** / **Add Row**).
- **Unreconciled Journal Lines**: entries in your books that are not yet matched.

### Match
- **Auto-Match** finds likely pairs for you.
- Or select a statement line on the left, then the matching journal line on the right.
- **Unmatch** to undo.

## Check the totals
The **Totals** show matched amounts and the remaining **Difference**. It should be zero when you finish.

## Complete or void
- **Complete** locks the reconciliation (you confirm first).
- **Void Reconciliation** releases all matched lines and needs a reason.

## When something doesn't match
- Missing transactions: import the statement or add the line, then post it.
- Timing differences (cheques not cleared): leave them unmatched for the next period.
- Wrong account: correct the journal and re-match.
- On the Banking page, use **Find Missing / Reconcile** to check an account for gaps.

## Tips
- Reconcile at least monthly.
- Reconcile each account separately.

pesa.title: Chart of Accounts
pesa.description: Create, seed and review your accounts and their ledgers
pesa.content:
# Chart of Accounts

The chart of accounts is the list of accounts used in every journal entry. Open **Chart of Accounts** in Pesa (or from the admin menu).

## Seed the defaults
On a fresh setup click **Seed Defaults** to create 40+ standard accounts. It is safe to run on a new setup. Accounts marked **SYSTEM** are required by the app.

## Add an account
Click **New Account** and fill in:
- **Account Code** and **Account Name**
- **Account Type** and **Account Subtype**
- **Parent Account** (optional; leave blank for top-level)
- **Description**
- **Is Parent / Header Account**: a heading that groups other accounts.
- **Is Bank / Cash Account**: tick this for money accounts, then add **Bank Name**, **Account Number** and **Branch**.

## What you see per account
Code, Type, Subtype, **Normal Balance** (debit or credit), **Current Balance** and Status. Search by account name or code.

## Account ledger
Click **View Ledger** to see every transaction on an account: **Date, Entry No., Reference, Source, Debit, Credit and Balance**. Pick a period (This Month, Last Month, Last 30/90 Days, This Year). It shows **Opening Balance**, **Total Debits**, **Total Credits** and **Closing Balance**. **Export** to Excel or PDF.

## Delete an account
You can delete an account only if it has not been used in journal entries.

## Tips
- Use a numbering pattern (for example 1xxx assets, 2xxx liabilities).
- Keep one account per bank account or till so reconciliation is easy.
- Do not change system accounts.

pesa.title: Invoices, Quotes & Payments
pesa.description: Create invoices, record payments, issue receipts and handle ETR
pesa.content:
# Invoices, Quotes & Payments

Open **Invoices** (the **Orders** page) to manage customer invoices. **Quotes** (in Mteja) uses the same list filtered to quotations.

## Find invoices
Use **Filter** and **Quick Filter** (Today, Yesterday, This Week and more), a **Date Range**, **Invoice No.**, **Order / Quote No.**, **Customer** or **Table Name**. Columns include status, balance due, overdue days, ETR status and who closed the order.

## Invoice details
Open an invoice to see items, subtotal, VAT, discount, grand total, payments and balance due, the journal entry, and who served and created it. You can **Edit Invoice Details** (customer address, phone, email, KRA PIN, payment terms) and **Edit Address**.

## Record a payment
1. Open the invoice and click **Make Payment**.
2. Enter the **Payment Amount** and **Payment Date**.
3. Choose the **method**: Cash, M-Pesa, Card, Bank Transfer or Cheque.
4. Select the **Deposit Account** (the bank or cash account receiving the money).
5. Add a reference and notes, then save.

Each payment creates a **Payment Receipt**. Use **Download Receipt** to print or save it as PDF. The **Payment History** and **Payment Receipts** tabs list everything received.

## Print and share
**Download / Print PDF** lets you choose a print template. Bank and Paybill details print at the bottom. If none are set, use **Add Bank Details** (see *Payment Methods*).

## Quotes
A quote is marked as a quotation only and is not a tax invoice. Use **Print Quote**, and **Convert to Invoice** when the customer accepts.

## Post, void, delete, duplicate
- **Post to Accounting**: create the journal entry if it is not yet posted.
- **Create Credit Note**: reduce the invoice (see *Credit & Debit Notes*).
- **Void Invoice**: reverses the journal entry and adds your void reason to the notes.
- **Duplicate**: copy an invoice.
- **Delete** removes the invoice, its items, stock updates, journal entry and payments. This cannot be undone, so prefer **Void**.

## eTIMS (ETR)
If eTIMS is enabled, the ETR status shows on the invoice. See *Etims Integration Guide*.

pesa.title: Sales Receipts
pesa.description: Record cash sales and post them to the books
pesa.content:
# Sales Receipts

A **Sales Receipt** records a sale that is paid immediately (cash, M-Pesa, card, bank or cheque), without needing an invoice first.

## Create a receipt
1. Open **Sales Receipts** and click **New Receipt**.
2. Choose the **date**, optional **customer** (leave blank for a cash sale) and payment method.
3. Set **VAT Pricing Mode** (Inclusive or Exclusive) and the **Standard VAT Rate**.
4. Add **line items**: description, quantity, unit price, discount and VAT type (Standard 16%, Zero Rated, Exempt, None or Out of Scope).
5. Under **Payment Details**, select the **Payment Account** (cash or bank) and a payment reference.
6. Choose the **Revenue Account** (required for posting).
7. Save.

## Statuses
- **Pending**: saved but not in the books.
- **Posted**: a journal entry has been created.

Click **Post** to create the journal entry (you'll be asked to confirm).

## Link to an invoice
If the money pays an existing invoice, choose **Link Invoice** and select it. The invoice's balance updates. You can **Unlink** later.

## Void and fix
- **Void** cancels a receipt (this cannot be undone).
- If a voided receipt still has a live journal entry, use **Fix Journal Entry** or **Fix Voided Journals** to void the entry.

## Details
Open a receipt to see line items, totals, who created and posted it, and the journal entry.

pesa.title: Expenses & Income
pesa.description: Record money out and money in, with VAT, approval and posting
pesa.content:
# Expenses & Income

## Expenses
Open **Expenses** to record money spent by the business.

### Add an expense
1. Click **Post Expense**.
2. Enter the **date**, **customer or payee**, **amount**, **payment method** and the **Expense Account (DR)**.
3. Add **input VAT**, a **reference** and notes.
4. Save.

### Approve and post
Expenses can wait for approval. Use **Approve & post to books** to create the journal entry. **Void expense** reverses it. Edit is available until it is posted.

### Summary cards
**Total Expenses** and **Input VAT**, filterable by **Today, This Week, This Month, This Quarter, This Year** or a customer.

## Income & Payments
The **Income** page shows money received. Use **Post Income / Expense** for items that do not come from a normal invoice. The cards show **Total Income** and **Total Outflow**. Download as **PDF** and choose a template.

## Tips
- Attach a reference number to every entry so you can find it in bank reconciliation.
- Record **input VAT** only when you hold a valid supplier invoice.
- For a vendor invoice you pay later, use **Bills** instead (see *Accounts Payable Management*).

pesa.title: Credit & Debit Notes
pesa.description: Adjust invoices and bills for returns, discounts and corrections
pesa.content:
# Credit & Debit Notes

Notes adjust a document you have already issued or received.

- A **credit note** reduces what a customer owes you (returns, discounts, corrections). It can also be a supplier credit.
- A **debit note** increases an amount owed (extra charges or under-billing).

## Create a note
1. Open **Debit/Credit Notes** and choose **Credit Notes** or **Debit Notes**.
2. Click to add one.
3. Select the **Customer** or **Supplier**.
4. Enter the **Original Invoice / Reference No.** and the **reason** (required).
5. Add lines: description, quantity, unit price, discount % and tax type (None, Zero Rated, Exempted or Out of Scope). Choose **Tax Exclusive** or **Tax Inclusive**.
6. Set the **issue date** and optional **expiry date**.
7. Add notes (visible to the customer or supplier) and internal notes.

## Statuses
- **Draft (Pending)**: can be edited or deleted.
- **Applied**: used against an invoice or bill. Applied notes cannot be edited.

## Apply a note
Open the note and click **Apply Note**. It reduces or increases the balance on the invoice or bill and creates the journal entry. Applied notes show on the document under *Credit Notes Applied*.

## Void
Voiding a note reverses its effect (**Note Void** appears as the journal source).

## Tip
If the original invoice was verified by KRA, issue a credit note rather than deleting the invoice, so the tax record stays correct.

pesa.title: Banking: Importing & Categorising Statements
pesa.description: Upload bank statements and let rules categorise the transactions
pesa.content:
# Banking: Importing & Categorising Statements

Open **Banking** (**Bank Statement Imports**) to bring bank transactions into Base.

## Import a statement
1. Click **Import Statement**.
2. Choose the **Bank Account** (a bank account in your chart of accounts).
3. Choose the **Import Method**:
   - **Excel / CSV – Map columns manually.** Match your columns to **Transaction Date**, **Description**, **Debit (Outflow)**, **Credit (Inflow)** or **Amount**, and **Reference / Cheque No**. Pick the date format that matches your file.
   - **PDF – Auto-detect.** Works with statements from major Kenyan banks (for example Equity, KCB, Absa).
4. **Preview** the parsed rows.
5. Import.

The imports list shows **Import No.**, account, file, period, number of transactions, debits and credits, and status: **Processing**, **Needs Review**, **Partially Complete**, **Complete** or **Voided**.

## Review transactions
Click **Review Transactions** to see each line. Assign each to an account, vendor or customer, and a tax treatment. Use **Verify Posting** to confirm the journal entries after posting. Use **Void** to cancel a wrong import.

## Categorisation rules
Click **Categorization Rules** > **New Rule** to teach Base to categorise automatically.
- Choose the **fields and conditions**: Description, Reference or Amount; Contains, Starts with, Ends with, Equals, Regex, or numeric comparisons.
- Match **all** or **any** criteria.
- **Record As**: Income, Expense, Transfer or Refund.
- Set the **account**, **vendor**, **VAT treatment**, reference and reporting tags.
- Choose which bank accounts it applies to.
- Tick **Allow Base to categorize my bank statements**, then activate the rule.

The rule shows how many transactions it **matches**.

## Next step
Once transactions are posted, reconcile the account (see *Bank Reconciliation*).

pesa.title: Multi-Currency
pesa.description: Set a base currency, add currencies and exchange rates
pesa.content:
# Multi-Currency

Open **Currencies** to manage the currencies used in your books.

## Base currency
Choose one **Base Currency** with **Set as Base**. All amounts are stored and reported in this currency (usually KES). If none is set the page prompts you.

## Add currencies
- Click **Seed Defaults** to add KES and 10 common currencies (safe to run more than once).
- Or add one: **ISO Code** (3 letters, for example USD), **Name**, **Symbol**, **Symbol Position**, **Decimal Places** and **Thousands Separator**.
- **Deactivate** a currency you no longer use.

## Exchange rates
1. Open the **Exchange Rates** tab and add a rate.
2. Choose **From** and **To** currencies and the **Rate** (1 FROM = X TO).
3. Set the **Effective Date**, **Source** (Manual or Central Bank) and notes.

## Currency converter
Use **Convert** to see the converted amount and the rate used.

## Export
**Export to Excel** for a currency or rate list.

## Where currencies are used
Assets, petty cash, employees' non-KES salaries, property leases and sale prices can use other currencies. Always keep rates up to date for accurate reports.

pesa.title: Asset Management
pesa.description: Register assets, issue them, depreciate them and keep maintenance records
pesa.content:
# Asset Management

Enable **Asset Manager** in **Discover**. It adds three pages to Pesa: **Asset Register**, **Asset Requests** and **Asset Maintenance**, plus **Asset Reports**.

## Asset Register
Click **Add New Asset** and complete:
- **Basic Info**: asset name and number, category (for example Equipment, Vehicles, Furniture, IT Equipment, Buildings, Intangible Assets), location, serial and tag number.
- **Financial Info**: purchase date, purchase cost, salvage value, **useful life (years)** and **depreciation method** (Straight Line, Reducing Balance or Units of Production).
- **Additional details**: condition, warranty expiry, department and custodian.

The cards show **Total Assets**, **Total Value** and **Accumulated Depreciation**. Status can be **Available**, **Assigned**, **In Maintenance**, **Retired** or **Disposed**.

### Actions on an asset
**Assign** to a custodian, **Return**, **Transfer** (new location or custodian), **Revalue** (new value with a reason), **Retire** and **Dispose** (date and disposal price). The asset's *Issuance History* records movements.

## Asset Requests
Staff can raise a **New Request** with the asset type, quantity, required-by date and justification. Approvers **Approve** or **Reject**, and the store **Issues** the asset. Statuses: Pending, Approved, Issued, Returned, Rejected.

## Asset Maintenance
Click **Schedule Maintenance** and choose the asset, type (**Preventive**, **Corrective**, **Emergency** or **Upgrade**), date, whether it is internal or external (technician or vendor) and the cost. Then **Start** the work and **Complete** it with the work performed and parts used, or **Cancel** with a reason.

## Asset Reports
Pick a fiscal year or month and run: Depreciation, Appreciation, Net Book Value, Asset Aging, Gain/Loss, Assets by Location, Assets by Custodian and Disposal reports. **Export Report** as needed.

mteja.title: Mteja CRM Introduction
mteja.description: Customers, leads, conversations, campaigns and targets in one workspace
mteja.content:
# Mteja CRM Introduction

Mteja by Base is the customer relationship module. It keeps every conversation, lead and campaign in one place so nothing falls through.

## The Mteja menu
| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Conversations, pipeline value, conversion and messaging at a glance |
| **Conversations** | The omnichannel inbox (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram) |
| **Stock** | Stock view for selling in WhatsApp (shown when the WhatsApp Marketplace is on) |
| **Leads** | Your sales pipeline |
| **Activity Calendar** | Calls, meetings, tasks and follow-ups |
| **Quotes** | Customer quotations |
| **Campaigns** | Marketing campaigns and budgets |
| **Sales Targets / Sales Budgets** | Goals and planned numbers |
| **Customers** | Your customer list |
| **Reports** | CRM reports |
| **Documents / E-Signature** | Contracts and signatures |

## The Mteja dashboard
The header has a **period filter** (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom) and, for admins, a branch selector. It shows:
- **KPI cards**: Conversations (with open and pending counts), Pipeline Value (and won value), Lead Conversion, and Engagement Health (average resolution time and resolution rate).
- **Lead Pipeline Progression**: a chart of leads by stage, switchable between count and deal value.
- **Engagement Mix**: conversations by status or by channel.
- **SMS & Email Messaging**: campaigns, quick sends, recipients, sent, failed and success rate.
- **CRM Operations Hub**: recent conversations, leads and customers, plus channel connection status.

## A typical flow
1. A customer messages you on WhatsApp.
2. An agent replies from the inbox and converts the chat to a **lead** or **customer**.
3. The lead moves through the pipeline, with activities logged and a **quote** sent.
4. Won leads convert into customers and orders.
5. Campaigns bring more people in. Targets and budgets track the results.

## Getting started
1. Enable Mteja in **Discover**.
2. Connect WhatsApp (see *The Omnichannel Inbox*).
3. Import or add your leads and customers.
4. Set up a **welcome message** and **reply scripts**.
5. Create a sales target for the team.

mteja.title: Lead Pipeline Management
mteja.description: Capture leads, move them through stages and convert them to customers
mteja.content:
# Lead Pipeline Management

**Leads** is your sales pipeline. Each lead tracks a prospect from first contact to a won or lost deal.

## Add a lead
Click **Add Lead** and fill in:
- **Entity Type**: Individual or Company (name or company name and contact person).
- **Phone** (required), **Email**, **Address** (street, city, county), **Source** (pick or add a new source) and **Project**.
- **Stage**, **Estimated Value (KES)**, **Win Probability (%)** and **Expected Close Date**.
- **Assign to** a team member, add **Tags** and notes.

## Import leads
Use **Import Leads** to upload an Excel file. Map the columns, preview the data and assign all leads to a staff member if you like. The summary shows created, updated and skipped rows.

## Stages
New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won and Lost (plus Disqualified). Use **Update Stage**, choose the new stage and add a note. **Stage History** records every change with who and when.

## Work a lead
Open a lead to see **Details**, **Contact Info**, **Activity History**, **Stage History** and **Documents**.
- **Log Activity**: choose the type (call, meeting, email and so on), add a subject, description and **outcome**, and set a **Next Follow-Up**.
- **Upload Document**: upload KRA certificates, IDs, proposals, quotations, contracts and more.

## Convert
When the lead is ready, use **Convert** (or **Quick Convert**) to create a customer from the lead. The lead is marked **Won** and linked to the new customer.

## Find and filter
Search by name or company, filter by stage, project and owner, and look for **Unassigned** or **Follow Up** leads.

## Pipeline view
The Mteja dashboard shows the pipeline by stage with counts and values, plus total value, won value and conversion rate. Switch the period filter to see trends.

mteja.title: Marketing Campaigns
mteja.description: Plan campaigns, set budgets and targets, and measure leads and revenue
mteja.content:
# Marketing Campaigns

**Campaigns** (Campaign Management) tracks your marketing activities and what they produce. (For sending SMS and email messages see *SMS & Email Campaigns*.)

## Create a campaign
Click **New Campaign** and enter:
- **Campaign Name**, **Type** and **Status**
- **Start Date** and **End Date**
- **Budget (KES)**
- **Target Leads** and **Target Revenue (KES)**
- **Target Audience** and **Description**
- Optional **Department** to scope the campaign
- **Tags**

## Track results
The campaign list and detail drawer show **Budget**, **Spend**, **Leads**, **Conversions** and **Revenue**, plus a **Lead Pipeline Breakdown** for leads that came from that campaign.

## Link leads to campaigns
When you add or import a lead, choose its campaign. Targets, budgets and reports then connect back to it.

## Reports
The **Campaign Performance** report in Mteja Reports shows budget versus actual spend, leads generated, conversions and ROI for each campaign.

## Tips
- Give each campaign a clear goal and a budget before starting.
- Compare cost per lead across campaigns before you spend more.
- Close campaigns when they end so reports stay tidy.

mteja.title: Loyalty, Gift Cards & Subscriptions
mteja.description: Reward repeat customers with packages, gift cards and visit tracking
mteja.content:
# Loyalty, Gift Cards & Subscriptions

Keep customers coming back with prepaid packages, gift cards and recognition.

## Packages and subscriptions
- Create **Subscription Packages** (a set number of visits for a price).
- Sell them to a customer. The **Subscriptions** tab shows each customer's package, **visits used and remaining**, expiry date and revenue.
- Filter to see active subscriptions **expiring within X days** and follow up.
- At the POS, a customer with an active package can **Use Subscription Visit** instead of paying. One visit is deducted and the screen warns when the package is **running low**.

## Gift cards
- **Issue Gift Card** to a customer, or **Create Gift Card for Non-Customer**.
- Enter the amount, recipient, email and expiry date.
- **Preview** and **Send Email** to deliver it.
- Customers can also buy gift cards on WhatsApp (see *Selling on WhatsApp*).

## Recognise your best customers
- **Top Customers by Spend** lists your highest spenders.
- **Award Candidates** highlights loyal customers worth rewarding.
- Visit history with ratings and reviews shows who is happy.

## Win back customers
Use the customer list and the activity calendar to follow up customers who haven't visited recently, and send them an SMS or email campaign.

mteja.title: The Omnichannel Inbox
mteja.description: Connect WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram and manage conversations as a team
mteja.content:
# The Omnichannel Inbox

**Conversations** brings your customer chats from several channels into one inbox.

## Connect a channel
Open **Conversations** and click **Connect Channel**.
- **WhatsApp**: link a device by scanning the **QR code** with the phone, or choose **Link with phone number instead** and enter your code. When connected the status shows **Connected**; use **Sync chats** to pull in recent chats from the phone, **Reconnect** if it drops, and **Disconnect** to log the device out.
- **Facebook Messenger**: chat with people who message your Facebook Page.
- **Instagram DMs**: reply to Instagram direct messages from the same inbox.

Some channels may show **Coming soon**.

## Find conversations
- Tabs and filters: **Open**, **Pending**, **Resolved**, **Closed**, **Needs reply**, and **Queue** for chats waiting on an agent.
- Filter by **All agents** or **Assigned to me**.
- **Search or start a new chat** from the search box.
- Badges show if a customer is in a **guided checkout**, **booking** or **pending dispatch**.

## Reply
- Type your message and send. Attach a **photo, video or PDF**.
- **Scripts**: insert a saved reply (see *Reply Scripts & Welcome Messages*).
- **Documents**: search your document centre by content and share a suggested file.
- **AI**: draft a reply with AI and edit it before sending.
- Use the message actions to send the **menu**, **catalogue**, **gift card** or **book** options (see *Selling on WhatsApp*).

## Work the conversation
From the conversation menu you can:
- **Assign** it to an agent.
- **Change status**: Pending, **Mark as resolved**, **Close conversation**.
- **Convert to Customer** or **Convert to Lead**.
- **Raise Ticket** for support follow-up.
- **Delete conversation** (with confirmation).

## Let the assistant help, then take over
For shops that use the WhatsApp assistant, the thread shows when the assistant is handling a customer. Choose **Take over** to stop the assistant and reply yourself.

## Broadcast and new messages
- **New Message**: send to a phone number with an optional contact name.
- **Broadcast**: send one message to **All Chats** (or a selection) and preview the recipients before it is queued.

## Tips
- Resolve conversations when they're done to keep the inbox clean.
- Assign owners so no chat is missed.
- Check **Needs reply** at the start of every shift.

mteja.title: Selling on WhatsApp (Marketplace)
mteja.description: Let customers shop, buy gift cards and book appointments inside WhatsApp
mteja.content:
# Selling on WhatsApp (Marketplace)

With the **WhatsApp Marketplace** turned on, customers can order straight from a chat. A **Stock** page also appears in the Mteja menu so you can keep your stock ready.

## What customers can do
They message keywords such as **MENU**, **ORDER** or **BOOK** and the assistant guides them:
- **Shop the catalogue**: a numbered catalogue, then the cart, then payment, then an **order code**.
- **Buy a gift card**: choose the amount, recipient and message, pay, and receive a **card code** to forward.
- **Book an appointment**: choose a service and day, then an open time slot, then confirm. They pay now or at the shop.
- **Talk to you**: ask for an agent at any time.

## Collect or deliver
The customer chooses **collect** or **delivery**. For delivery they give an address and a **delivery fee** is added.

## Payment
The customer picks how to pay, from numbered options. For M-Pesa, **the payment SMS is checked automatically** and the order is confirmed.

## What you see in the inbox
- Chats in a guided flow are marked **Checkout** or **Booking**.
- Orders move to **Pending Dispatch** so an agent can be assigned to deliver them.
- Use **Sell in chat** to build an order for the customer yourself: add products, services or a gift card, set the delivery fee, choose collect or delivery and **Place order**.
- The **Chat Orders** drawer shows orders created from conversations.

## Analytics
Open **Marketplace** in Conversations analytics to see **Chat sales**, **Orders**, **Average order value**, **Chat conversion**, **Gift cards sold**, **Bookings in chat**, and customers **in checkout now**.

## Getting started
1. Connect WhatsApp.
2. Make sure your inventory and services have prices.
3. Turn on the marketplace for the shop.
4. Add a welcome message that tells customers they can type **MENU** (see *Reply Scripts & Welcome Messages*).
5. Test the whole flow with your own phone before telling customers.

mteja.title: Reply Scripts & Welcome Messages
mteja.description: Save canned replies and greet new customers automatically
mteja.content:
# Reply Scripts & Welcome Messages

## Welcome message
The **Automated Welcome Message** is sent automatically the first time a customer messages you on WhatsApp.
1. Open the welcome message settings.
2. Pick **Start from a template** or write your own, for example *Hi! Welcome to our shop. How can we help you today?*
3. Optionally add a line telling customers they can shop in chat (each line adds a keyword the assistant answers).
4. Use the AI helper to improve the text if you like (you can say how it should change it).
5. Check the **Customer preview** and **Save welcome message**.

If none is saved the card shows **Not set up**.

## Reply scripts
**Scripts** are saved replies agents can insert with one click.
- **New Script**: add a **Title**, **Category** and **Script Content**.
- **Improve with AI**: refine the text with optional instructions.
- **Search scripts** by title or content, then **Use Script** in a conversation.
- Edit, copy the text, or delete scripts you no longer need.
- Start from **Marketplace starter scripts** such as MENU, ORDER and BOOK replies, paying with M-Pesa, collection and delivery, gift cards, and order status.
- You can also upload a PDF or document to build scripts from it.

## Tips
- Keep scripts short and friendly, and use the customer's name.
- Create variants such as **Friendly**, **With hours** and **Busy period**.
- Review scripts quarterly so prices and hours stay correct.

mteja.title: Agents & Chat Analytics
mteja.description: Assign team members to chats and measure response and sales
mteja.content:
# Agents & Chat Analytics

## Add agents
1. Open **Agents** in Conversations.
2. Click **Add an agent**.
3. **Select a user** from your team and choose **Make Agent**.
4. Remove an agent with **Remove from agents** (with confirmation).

Each agent has a status (**Online**, **Busy**) and a count of open conversations.

## Agent performance
Pick **Last 7, 30 or 90 days** to see per agent:
- Conversations handled and messages sent
- Upsell messages and **conversion**
- **Resolution** rate
- **Average and median first response time**
- Chat sales over the last 30 days from offers the agent sent

## Inbox analytics
The **Analytics** page has an **Inbox** view with:
- **Total conversations**, **resolved/closed**, **messages**, and **average messages per conversation**
- **Customers**, **active agents**, and **service quality** (resolution rate and response times)
- For marketplace shops: **Sales & dispatch** (pending dispatch, average dispatch wait) and **customer conversion**

## AI insights
Open **AI Insights** for a short summary of what is **going well**, what to **watch**, and what to **try**. You can **Regenerate** it or **Copy insights**. It needs some conversation history first.

## Tips
- Review first-response time weekly; fast replies win sales.
- Use the dashboards in the Mteja home for a quick daily check.

mteja.title: SMS & Email Campaigns
mteja.description: Connect a sender, send to customers or leads and track delivery
mteja.content:
# SMS & Email Campaigns

Send bulk or one-off SMS and email from **Campaigns** in Conversations. The flow is: **connect a sender, pick an audience, write and send**.

## 1. Connect a sender
Click **Sender settings** > **Connect a sender** and pick a provider.

**SMS providers:** Onfon Media, Twilio, Africa's Talking, or **Other (custom HTTP gateway)**.
**Email providers:** Brevo (Sendinblue), Mailchimp Transactional, SendGrid, **SMTP (any mail server)**, or **Other (custom HTTP API)**.

Enter the credentials the provider needs (for example username and API key, account SID and auth token, or SMTP host, port and password). Set a sender ID or from-email, and a label.
- **Send a test message** to check it works. The sender shows **Verified** or **Test failed**.
- Mark one sender as **Default** for the channel.
- **Disconnect** a sender at any time.

## 2. Quick Send
**Quick send** is for one-off messages: choose the sender, enter the recipient (name optional) and write your message.

## 3. New campaign
1. Click **New campaign** and give it a **Campaign Name**. You can link it to a marketing campaign.
2. Choose **Send From** (the sender).
3. For email, enter a **Subject** and choose an **Email Template**; use **Preview template**.
4. Write the message. Use placeholders like {{name}} to personalise.
5. Choose **Send To**: **Customers**, **Leads**, **Both**, **Import Excel** (upload a file or download the template), or **Paste List**.
6. **Create Campaign** to save a draft, or **Send now**.

## Track delivery
The campaign list shows **Recipients**, **Sent**, **Delivered**, **Failed** and **Delivery rate**, with statuses such as **Drafts**, **Sending** and **Completed**. Open **View details** to see each recipient and any error, and **Refresh status**.

## Results on the dashboard
The Mteja dashboard shows SMS and email totals for the selected period: campaigns, quick sends, recipients, sent, failed and success rate.

## Tips
- Always send a test first.
- Keep SMS short and include your business name.
- Only message customers who have agreed to hear from you.

mteja.title: Activity Calendar
mteja.description: Schedule calls, meetings, tasks and follow-ups against leads and customers
mteja.content:
# Activity Calendar

The **Activity Calendar** tracks lead and customer engagement. Open it from the Mteja menu.

## Views
- **Month** and **Week** views.
- Filter by **activity type** and **status** (**Open**, **Done**, **Cancelled**).

## Add an activity
Click **New Activity** and choose:
- **Link To**: a lead or a customer.
- **Activity Type**: Call, Email, Meeting, Demo, Note, Task, WhatsApp, Site Visit, Ticket or Other.
- **Subject**, **Description** and **Priority** (Medium, High, Urgent).
- **Date & Time**.
- For meetings: the **location** (Online, In Person or Phone), a **Meeting Link** or physical place, and **Invite Team Members**.
- An optional **Follow-up Date**.

## Manage activities
Click an activity to **Mark Done**, **Mark Cancelled**, **Reschedule**, **Edit** or **Delete**. For online meetings use **Join meeting**.

## Tips
- Log an activity after every customer contact so the history is complete.
- Check the calendar each morning, and filter to **Open** to see what's due.
- Use priorities to flag urgent follow-ups.

mteja.title: Sales Targets & Budgets
mteja.description: Set goals for people and teams, and plan revenue, COGS and expenses
mteja.content:
# Sales Targets & Budgets

## Sales Targets
Open **Sales Targets** to set and track team performance goals.

### Create a target
Click **New Target** and set:
- **Target Name**, **Metric Type** (what you are measuring) and **Target Value**
- **Period Start** and **Period End**
- **Assign To**: a **Specific User**, a **Role** (everyone with that role), a **Department**, or a **free-text team label**
- Optional **Link to Campaign** to count only results from that campaign
- Notes

The list shows **Actual**, **Achievement** percentage and the period. When the goal is reached you see **Target Achieved!**.

## Sales Budgets
Open **Sales Budgets** to plan your numbers.

### Create a budget
Click **New Budget** and enter a name, period and the planned **Revenue**, **COGS** and **Expenses** (KES). The system calculates **Gross Profit**. Optionally link a campaign or department.

### Approval
Submit the budget with **Submit for Approval**. An approver can **Approve** or **Reject** it (a rejection reason is recorded). Details show who submitted and approved it.

### Budget vs actual
Each budget shows **Budgeted**, **Actual** and **Variance** so you can see how you are doing.

## Reports
The **Sales Target vs Actual** report shows target and actual revenue and customers with an achievement rate, by period.

## Tips
- Set targets that a person can influence.
- Review progress mid-period, not only at the end.

mteja.title: Quotes
mteja.description: Create customer quotations and turn them into invoices
mteja.content:
# Quotes

**Quotes** lets you create and manage customer quotations.

## Create a quote
1. Open **Quotes** in the Mteja menu.
2. Create a new quote for the customer, add the items, quantities, prices and VAT.
3. Save it. Quotes have their own numbers and show a note that the document is *a quotation only and does not constitute a tax invoice*.

## Share it
Use **Print Quote** to print or save a PDF with your logo and business details.

## When the customer accepts
Use **Convert to Invoice**. The quote becomes an invoice you can post to accounting, record payments against and, if eTIMS is on, submit to KRA.

## Find quotes
Search by number, customer or date, using the same filters as invoices.

## Tip
Link the quote to a lead and log an activity so your sales pipeline reflects the proposal. Upload the signed version using *E-Signature*.

mteja.title: Mteja Reports
mteja.description: Customer, lead, campaign, target, visit and activity reports
mteja.content:

Depending on the report: lifecycle stage, source, assigned user, customer type (Individual or Business), stage, period (Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly), year and date range.

dala.title: Dala Property Management
dala.description: Properties, units, leases, sales, commissions and maintenance

Dala by Base manages real-estate portfolios for both **sales** (developments, plots) and **rentals** (leases).

dala.title: Lease & Rent Management
dala.description: Create leases, set terms and deposits, and generate rent invoices
dala.content:
# Lease & Rent Management

Open **Leases & Rentals** to manage tenants and rent. Cards show **Total Leases/Rentals**, total amount and those **Expiring Soon**. Filter by status, type, property and date, or search.

## Create a lease
Click **New Lease/Rental**. The form has three steps:

### 1. Lease details
Property, unit, **occupant (tenant)**, **lease type** (Monthly, Short Stay, Annual, Lease to Own, Commercial), start and end dates, unit area, currency and lease amount (or amount per sqm).

### 2. Payment terms
**Payment frequency** (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annually, Annually), **payment due day**, **deposit** (amount, paid, paid date, refunded and deductions), **service charge** and its frequency, and **utilities the tenant pays** (electricity, internet, garbage and so on).

### 3. Terms & submit
Status (Active, Notice, Expired, Terminated, Vacated), signed date, notice and vacate dates, **termination reason**, **escalations** and **documents**.

## Rent escalations
Add a **lease escalation** with an effective date and either a **fixed amount** or a **percentage**. The new rent and when it was applied are recorded.

## Deposits and charges
Use **Update Deposit** to record payment, refund and deductions, and **Update Service Charge** to change it.

## Generate rent invoices
Click **Generate Invoices** (or **Generate Bulk Invoices**). Choose the **period start and end** and the **due date** to invoice all active leases at once.

## Collect rent
In **Rent Collection** see **Total Billed**, **Collected**, **Outstanding** and **Paid Invoices**, and record payments by method. Payments flow to accounting if Pesa is enabled.

## Tips
- Keep tenant documents on the lease (ID, agreement).
- Review **Expiring Soon** monthly to start renewals early.

dala.title: Maintenance Management
dala.description: Raise tickets, assign work, add updates and record costs
dala.content:
# Maintenance Management

Open **Maintenance** for property tickets and general support tickets.

## Dashboard cards
**Total Tickets**, **Open Tickets**, **In Progress**, **Urgent Tickets**, **Estimated Cost** and **Actual Cost**.

## Create a ticket
Click **New Ticket**:
- **Ticket Type**: Property maintenance or General.
- **Property**, **Unit/Apartment**, **Lease** and **Occupant** (a property is required for maintenance tickets).

Run the **Maintenance** report in Dala Reports by date, category and status to see tickets with estimated and actual cost.

dala.title: Property Analytics & Reports

dala.title: Properties, Blocks & Units
dala.description: Set up a property with its blocks, apartments, plots and pricing phases
dala.content:
# Properties, Blocks & Units

## Property types
Open **Property Types** and click **Add Property Type**. Enter a **name**, **slug** and description, and set the status to Active or Inactive.

## Create a property
Click **New Property**. The form follows two steps:
1. **Basic Information**: property name, **type**, **purpose** (sale, rental or mixed), location and manager.
