dala.title: Property Sales, Payment Plans & Commissions
dala.description: Sell units or plots, schedule instalments and pay agents
dala.content:
# Property Sales, Payment Plans & Commissions

## Record a sale
Open **Sales** and click **Create**. The form has three steps:

### 1. Sale details
Choose the **property**, **unit** (or individual **apartment**, where the price fills in automatically), the **client**, **list price**, **sale price** and **sale date**. Tick **Joint Purchase** to add 2 to 10 customers.

### 2. Payment details
- **Initial payment type**: a non-refundable **Booking Fee** or a custom **Down Payment**.
- **Payment plan**: **Full Payment**, **Installment** or **Mortgage**.
- For installments choose the **frequency** (weekly to annually) and number, then **Generate Payment Plan** or add installments manually.
- Choose the payment method and date.

### 3. Terms & submit
Attach supporting documents, choose the **sales agent** and **property manager**, set the **commission rate**, and use **Split Commission** to divide it between several users. Choose the status: Reservation, Agreement, Processing, Completed or Cancelled.

## Record payments
Open a sale and **Add Payment** as the client pays. Progress shows against the payment plan.

## Commissions
Open **Commissions**. Cards show **Total Sales**, **Total Sales Value**, **Amount Paid by Clients**, **Accrued Commission**, **Total Commission**, **Paid Commission** and **Pending Commission**.

Commission is earned **based on what clients have actually paid**, so an agent's accrued commission grows as the client pays.

### Pay a commission
1. Select the agents and open the sale.
2. Click **Add Payment**.
3. Choose who to pay, the **gross amount** (it cannot exceed **Available to Pay**), the date and the method.
4. Optionally **apply withholding tax**; the net amount is shown.
5. Add the reference number, notes and **payment documents** (receipt, proof, M-Pesa confirmation, withholding tax certificate and so on).

Export to PDF from the commission screen.

etims.title: Etims Integration Guide
etims.description: Enable KRA eTIMS and track the tax status of each invoice
etims.content:
# Etims Integration Guide

## What is eTIMS?
eTIMS is the Kenya Revenue Authority's electronic tax invoicing system. When enabled, your invoices are submitted to KRA and receive a control-unit signature and a QR code that customers can scan to verify.

## Before you start
- Your shop needs a valid **KRA PIN**. Add it in the shop's company details (the invoice screen reminds you if it is missing).
- VAT should be configured under **Settings > VAT Config**.
- Know that **billing applies** for eTIMS.

## Enable eTIMS
1. Open **Discover**.
2. Find **eTIMS Integration** and click **Enable**.
3. Accept the billing notice.
4. The app reloads with eTIMS turned on.

## ETR status on an invoice
Open an invoice and find the **ETR / KRA DigiTax** panel. The status can be:
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **ETR Disabled** | eTIMS is not enabled for this invoice |
| **In Flight** | Sent to KRA, waiting for a response |
| **Submitted to KRA** | KRA received it |
| **ETR Verified** | Accepted by KRA. QR code and receipt link are available |
| **ETR Failed** | Rejected or errored. See the **DigiTax Error** message |

Use **Refresh ETR Status** to check again, and **Verify with KRA** or **View KRA Receipt** once verified.

## What the invoice shows
When verified, the invoice prints the **CU serial number**, **receipt number**, **receipt signature**, **control unit invoice number**, the SCU information and a **QR code** ("Scan to Verify ETR").

## Quotes and submitting
Quotations are not tax invoices and are not submitted. **Convert to Invoice** first, then submit. You can also use **Submit Etims** from the invoice actions.

## Troubleshooting
- **KRA PIN not configured**: add the PIN in the shop settings.
- **ETR Failed**: read the DigiTax error, fix the invoice data (for example a missing item tax type) and refresh the status.
- **Stuck on In Flight**: use **Refresh ETR Status** after a minute. If it stays, contact support.

etims.title: VAT Compliance & Reporting
etims.description: Configure VAT, price items correctly and run VAT reports
etims.content:
# VAT Compliance & Reporting

## Configure VAT
Open **Settings > VAT Config** and set:
- **VAT Status**: enable VAT for your business.
- **Pricing Mode**: whether the selling prices you enter are **Tax Inclusive** or **Tax Exclusive**.
- **VAT Rate**: the standard rate (16%).

Save with **Save Tax Settings**.

## Tax types on lines
On sales receipts, invoices and notes each line has a VAT type:
- **Standard (16%)**
- **Zero Rated (0%)**
- **Exempt**
- **Out of Scope**

Choose the correct type so the VAT report is accurate.

## Where VAT is tracked
- **Invoices and receipts** show subtotal, total VAT and total.
- **Expenses** record **input VAT** you can claim.
- **Supplier bills** carry VAT on purchases.
- **Credit and debit notes** adjust VAT on the original invoice.

## VAT reports
- **Duka Reports > VAT Report** summarises VAT on POS sales.
- **Pesa Reports > VAT Report** shows **VAT Collected**, **VAT Paid** and the net position by source.

Pick the period (for example This Month or This Quarter), run the report and **Export** to CSV, Excel or PDF for your return.

## Good practice
- Reconcile VAT monthly.
- Keep supplier invoices with valid PINs.
- Review exempt and zero-rated items for correct tagging.
- Use eTIMS so each invoice is verified by KRA.

bandu.title: Bandu HR Overview
bandu.description: Employees, attendance, leave and payroll in one HR module
bandu.content:
# Bandu HR Overview

Bandu by Base handles people operations: employee records, attendance, leave and Kenyan payroll with statutory deductions.

## The Bandu menu
| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Workforce, attendance, leave and payroll summary |
| **Employees** | Employee records, contracts, salaries and documents |
| **Payroll** | Generate, approve, process and pay payroll |

| **Leave / Leave Policies / Leave Calendar / Leave Approvals** | Leave requests, rules and approvals |
| **Crew Management** | The user accounts staff sign in with |
| **Reports** | HR and payroll reports |

## The Bandu dashboard
Use the **Filter Period** (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom) to view:
- **Active Workforce**, **Attendance Rate**, **Leave Requests** and **Net Payroll**.
- **Workforce breakdown** by department, leave status and gender.
- Upcoming **birthdays** this month and **documents expiring soon**.
- Recent leave requests and attendance.

## Set up in this order
1. Enable Bandu in **Discover**.
2. Set up **Deduction Settings** (NSSF, PAYE, SHIF/SHA, Housing Levy, NITA).
3. Create **Leave Policies**.
4. Add **Employees** (or import them).

Staff with a login see **Crew** pages for their own schedule, attendance and leave balance, and can apply for leave.

bandu.title: Managing Wages & Payroll
bandu.description: Generate, approve, process and pay payroll, then issue payslips
bandu.content:
# Managing Wages & Payroll

## Payroll workflow
1. **Generate Payroll** for a month: choose the period, departments, and options such as **Round off amounts (whole KES)**.
2. Review the lines. **Edit Lines** to adjust salary, allowances, overtime or deductions for any employee (with a reason).
3. **Approve** (or **Reject to Drafts** with a reason).
4. **Process**.
5. **Mark Paid** when the money is sent. The system can **create the accounting accounts and post the salary payment to Pesa** if they are missing.
6. **Generate Payslips**.

## Payroll statuses
**Draft**, **Pending Approval**, **Approved**, **Processed**, **Paid** and **Void**.

## What each line shows
**Basic pay**, allowances, overtime, **gross pay**, **NSSF**, **SHIF**, **Housing Levy**, pension, taxable pay, **income tax**, **personal relief**, **insurance relief**, **PAYE**, withholding tax, other deductions and **net pay**. Employer-side **NITA** is shown too.

## Supplementary runs
If employees join after the main payroll, run a **supplementary payroll** for just those people.

## Totals and exports
Cards show **Total Gross**, **Total Deductions**, **Total Net**, employees and departments. **Export** the register, and use **Filing Templates** for **NSSF**, **SHIF** and **PAYE** returns.

## Payslips and P9
Open **Payslips** to:
- Filter by month, employee or department.
- **View**, **Download PDF**, **Export Excel** or **Email Payslip** (or **Email All / Email Selected**).
- Choose a layout: *Summary*, *Detailed*, *Classic*, *Statement* or *Minimal*, and a brand header.
- Generate the annual **P9 Form** per employee (preview, Excel in the official format, PDF, or email).

## Wages (daily/weekly)
In the admin menu, **Wages** stores wage structures for staff paid daily, weekly or monthly, with allowances, deductions and overtime rate.

## Tips
- Close attendance and leave for the month before generating payroll.
- Approve and process in the same session to avoid mix-ups.
- Keep P9s for the full tax year.

bandu.title: Employee Management
bandu.description: Add employees, contracts, salaries, bank and statutory details
bandu.content:
# Employee Management

Open **Employees** in Bandu. Switch between **List** and **Cards**, and search by name, email, ID number, job title or branch.

## Add an employee
Click **Add Employee**. The form has steps:

### Basic Info
First, middle and last name, email, phone, ID number, department (pick one or add a new one), job title and branch. You can link the employee to an existing user (**Select Crew Member**) so they can sign in. The **Employee Number** is auto-generated.

### Employment
- **Employment Type**: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Intern, Casual or Consultant.
- **Employee Type**: Primary or Secondary.
- **Hire Date** and employment status.
- **Salary**, **Salary Basis** (Gross or Net), **Currency**, and **Payment Frequency** (Weekly, Bi-weekly or Monthly). Non-KES salaries are converted to KES using the currency's exchange rate.

### Banking & Tax
Bank name, account number and branch, **KRA PIN**, **NSSF number**, **SHA number**, **residential status** (Resident or Non-Resident), and HELB.

### Pension & Insurance
Pension contribution (monthly, with the legal cap), and insurance policy details with provider, policy number, start date, contribution amount and frequency. Insurance relief is calculated at 15% of the premium, capped at KES 5,000 per month.

### Deduction exemptions
Tick any deductions that do not apply to this person: PAYE, SHA, NHIF (legacy), NITA, Withholding Tax, HELB or Pension.

### Personal
Date of birth, gender, blood group, marital status, nationality, and **Person with Disability (PWD)** with a certificate number and upload (PWD exemptions need a certificate).

### Emergency contact
Name, phone and relationship.

## Allowances and benefits
Open an employee and add **Allowances** (with frequency and whether taxable) and **Benefits**. Defaults can be set in **Payroll Settings** under System Setup.

## Import and export
Use **Template**, **Import** and **Export** to move many employees in and out of Excel.

## Status changes
- **Suspend** (with period and reason).
- **Terminate** (with date and reason).
- **Reinstate** an employee as active again.
- **Delete permanently** only when the record should not exist.

bandu.title: Attendance & Clock-in
bandu.description: Staff clock-in by QR/link or biometric device, with attendance reports
bandu.content:
# Attendance & Clock-in

## How staff clock in
- **Clock-in screen:** staff open *Clock In to Start Your Day or Clock Out to End Your Day* and tap in or out.
- **QR code / link:** under Attendance, open **Staff Clock-In Link & QR**. **Copy URL** or **Download QR Code** and post it at the workplace. Staff scan it with their phone to clock in.
- **Biometric devices:** connect a fingerprint or face device so punches sync automatically (see below).
- **Manual entries** can be added by managers.

## Attendance page
Pick a period and see each record: staff, date, **clock in**, **clock out**, hours, **source** (Biometric or Manual) and status (**Clocked In** or **Completed**). Cards show **Sessions**, **Active Now** and **Total Hours**. A banner shows **Your Status Today**.

You can delete a session; this removes the clock record and its attendance summary.

## Attendance dashboard
For managers: **Present Today**, **Absent Today**, **Late Arrivals**, **On Leave**, **Pending Leave** and the **Attendance Rate**.

## Biometric devices
In **System Setup > Biometrics**:
1. Pick the **provider**: ZKTeco, Suprema, Anviz, Hikvision or Other.
2. Choose the **connection mode**: *Polling* (Base pulls logs from the device) or *Push* (the device sends punches to Base).
3. Enter the device host/IP, port, sync interval, communication key and serial number.
4. Turn on **Enable Biometric Sync**, **Save**, and **Test Connection**.

## Reports
Run **Staff Hours Worked** in Reports to see total hours, completed sessions, open sessions, first clock-in and last activity per employee. Export to Excel or PDF.

bandu.title: Leave Management
bandu.description: Policies, requests, approvals and the leave calendar
bandu.content:
# Leave Management

## Leave policies
Open **Leave Policies** and click **Create Policy**. Use templates such as *Statutory Kenyan leave entitlement*, a minimal annual + sick policy, or one with higher allowances including study leave.

For each **leave type** (Annual, Sick, Emergency, Maternity, Paternity, Unpaid) set:
- **Default days** and **Max days**
- **Is Paid**
- **Carry forward**
- **Requires document**

**Approval settings:**
- **Auto-approve days**: short leaves approved automatically.
- **Max consecutive days** and **Notice period (days)**.
- **Pro-rata calculation**: by Calendar Year, Employment Year or Joining Date.

Choose a **department** for a department-specific policy; leave it empty for the default. Use **Init Balances** (Initialize Leave Balances) to create balances for staff.

## Apply for leave
1. Open **Leave** (or **My Leave** under Crew) and click **Apply for Leave**.
2. Choose the leave type and dates. The form shows working days requested and your balance remaining.
3. Add a reason and, if required, **upload a supporting document**.
4. **Submit Application**.

Your requests show as **Pending**, **Approved** or **Rejected**. You can **withdraw** or **cancel** a request. Cancelling an approved leave returns the days to your balance.

## Approvals
Managers open **Leave Approvals**, review the request details (days, reason, attachments) and **Approve** or **Reject** with an optional reason.

## Leave calendar
**Leave Calendar** shows who is away: choose **All Leaves** or **My Leaves**. Cards show **Total Leaves**, **Pending**, **Approved** and **On Leave Today**.

## Leave entitlements
Managers can search staff and see each person's entitlement, used, pending and remaining days; unset entitlements show **Not configured**.

bandu.title: Payroll Deductions & Statutory Settings
bandu.description: Configure NSSF, PAYE, SHIF/SHA, Housing Levy, NITA and custom deductions
bandu.content:
# Payroll Deductions & Statutory Settings

Open **Deduction Settings** (under Payroll) to control how pay is calculated.

## Quick start
Use **Auto-fill Kenyan Rates** (Initialize Defaults) to load the standard statutory settings, then review each one and **Save Settings**.

## Statutory deductions
- **NSSF**: turn on the deduction and set the rate and the **Tier 1** and **Tier 2** upper limits.
- **PAYE**: set the **personal relief**, **minimum taxable income** and the **tax brackets** (limit and rate for each, plus the rate above the last limit).
- **SHA / SHIF**: employee rate and income limit.
- **Housing Levy**: enable and set the rate and employee share.
- **NITA**: amount per employee (paid by the employer).

## Custom deductions
Click **Add Custom Deduction** to add your own (for example a staff loan or union dues) with a name and amount.

## Per-employee settings
On each employee you can add **allowances** and **benefits**, set **exemptions** (for example PWD, HELB) and record **pension** and **insurance** relief.

## Payroll settings
Under **System Setup > Payroll Settings**:
- How a **partial first month** is paid (pro-rated by days worked, or a fixed percentage).
- The **payslip export header** (company name or department name).
- Whether to **hide the employer name and PIN on P9 forms**.
- **Default allowances and benefits**.

## Tip
Change statutory rates only when the law changes, and always generate a test payroll afterwards.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard Overview
admin.description: Your control centre: dashboards, branches, staff, documents and settings
admin.content:
# Admin Dashboard Overview

The **Admin** area is for owners and managers who look after the whole business across all branches.

## Admin menu
| Item | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | One tab per enabled module (Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala) |
| **Business Health** | An overall health score for the business |
| **Reports** | Consolidated reports for every module |
| **Branch Management** | Create and manage branches and their POS mode |
| **Crew Management** | Users, roles and attendance |
| **Document Center** | Folders, cheques, invoices and contracts |
| **Chart of Accounts** | Quick link to accounting accounts |

The top bar gives you **Notifications**, **Billing**, **Settings**, **Discover**, **Help Center** and **Logout**.

## Dashboard tabs
Each module has its own tab. Every tab has a **period filter** (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom) and a branch selector where it applies.

- **Duka:** revenue, orders, growth, active shops and shifts, **Sales Pulse** chart, **Top Sellers** and an **Operations Hub** (orders, low stock, purchase orders). A banner appears when items are low or depleted.
- **Pesa:** financial summary and receivables/payables.
- **Mteja:** conversations, pipeline, conversion, messaging.
- **Bandu:** workforce, attendance, leave and payroll.
- **Dala:** portfolio, rent, commissions and maintenance.

The tab you last used is remembered.

## Business Health and Biashara AI
- **Business Health** scores performance across six dimensions (see *Business Health Score*).
- **Biashara AI** is an assistant that answers questions about your business (see *Biashara AI Assistant*).

## Daily admin routine
1. Check each dashboard for the day.
2. Review low-stock and out-of-stock alerts.
3. Check pending approvals (leave, refunds, petty cash).
4. Glance at notifications.

admin.title: Managing Shops & Branches
admin.description: Create branches, pick a POS mode and manage them centrally
admin.content:
# Managing Shops & Branches

Open **Branch Management** in the admin menu.

## The branch list
Each branch shows its **name**, **mode**, **staff** count, **today's revenue**, and location. Use the search box to find branches. Actions include **Open Shop**, **Copy address**, **Print Settings** and **Delete shop**.

## Add a branch
1. Click **New Branch**.
2. Enter the **Branch Name**.
3. Search and confirm the **Location** (the map confirms it).
4. Choose the **POS Mode**:
   - **Duka Services**: restaurants and service businesses.
   - **Retail**: shops with a product counter.
   - **Hospital**: departments and pharmacy.
   - **Hotel**: rooms and floors.
5. Save.

## After creating a branch
1. Set up **Categories**, **Products/Services** and **Payment Methods**.
2. In restaurants, add **Table locations and tables**.
3. In hotels, add **Locations and Rooms**.
4. Add staff in **Crew Management** and set their branch.
5. Configure printers and receipt details in **System Setup**.

## Working across branches
Many pages have a **Branch** filter and an **All Branches** option, so you can compare branches or focus on one. Use **Print Settings** to adjust printing for a specific branch.

## Delete a branch
**Delete shop** asks you to confirm and cannot be undone. Export any reports you need first.

admin.title: Customer Management
admin.description: See all customers across branches with spend, orders and gift cards
admin.content:
# Customer Management

In the admin area, **Customers** shows every customer across all branches.

## The list
For each customer you see **name**, **phone**, **email**, **total spent**, **number of orders**, **unreplied messages** and **last visit**. Search and export the list to Excel or PDF.

## Customer details
Open a customer to see contact info, documents, engagement, orders and **visit history** with ratings and reviews.

## Gift cards
Admins can see all gift cards:
- **All Gift Cards** and **Customer Gift Cards**
- **Non-Customer Gift Cards**
- **Issue New Gift Card** with an amount, recipient, email and expiry date
- **Preview** and **Send Email**

## Related
For adding and importing customers, packages and subscriptions see *Customers, Packages & Gift Cards*.

admin.title: System Settings & Configuration
admin.description: Business profile, receipts, printers, payroll, hotel and more
admin.content:
# System Settings & Configuration

There are two settings areas.

## 1. Settings (tenant level, admin)
Open **Settings** in the top bar. Tabs:
- **Basic Info**: business name, email, phone. It also shows business type, size, created date and **next billing**.
- **VAT Config**: VAT status, **pricing mode** (Tax Inclusive or Exclusive) and **VAT rate**.
- **Logo & Branding**: logo and **colour scheme** (Primary, Secondary, Accent, Background) with a live preview.

## 2. System Setup (per branch)
Pick a branch and open **System Setup**. Sections include:
| Section | What you set |
|---|---|
| **Business Profile** | Business name, email, phone, location, social link, KRA PIN, P.O. Box |
| **Payment Methods** | M-Pesa and bank payment details printed on documents |
| **Receipt Print Appearance** | Font size and weight with a live preview |
| **Printer Management** | Print Agent, printers, default printer, category routing, test print |
| **Printing Controls** | Print limits, saved copies, reprint rules |
| **Privacy Settings** | Rules such as not printing a bill before it is paid |
| **Warranty text** | Receipt warranty and note lines |
| **Notification Settings** | Channels for customer notifications (email, WhatsApp) |
| **WhatsApp Secondary Alerts** | Extra phone numbers to notify |
| **Hotel Settings** | Check-in times, WiFi, rules, amenities, policies |
| **Payroll Settings** | Partial month, payslip header, default allowances |
| **Biometric Devices** | Attendance device connection |
| **Secondary Database Sync** | Scheduled sync of data to a second database |
| **Bank / Payment Details** | Bank info for invoices (pick a bank to auto-fill paybill) |

## Secondary database sync
Advanced: enter a MongoDB URI, a daily sync time and timezone, choose which collections to sync (sales and payments, catalogue and stock, purchasing, crew), and **Sync Now** with options for full re-sync. Use only if your IT team asked for it.

## Tips
- Set the **KRA PIN** and **VAT** before you issue invoices.
- Test print after every printer change.
- Review settings after adding a new branch.

admin.title: Users, Roles & Permissions
admin.description: Add users, assign roles and control exactly what each person can do
admin.content:
# Users, Roles & Permissions

## Users (Crew Management)
Open **Crew Management** or **Staff Management**. You can:
- **Search** by name or email, and filter by **role**, **branch** and **status**.
- Add or edit a user: name, username, email, phone, role and branch.
- Change status:
  - **Suspend**: cannot log in until reactivated.
  - **Terminate**: blocks all access; can be reinstated.
  - **Reactivate / Reinstate**: sets them back to Active.
  - **Delete**: removes the user (admin users cannot be deleted).
- Open a user to see **Clock In / Out History**, total shifts, completed and active sessions. Export to Excel or PDF.

## Roles
Open **Role Settings**. Each role shows its type and a **Permission Preview**. The list shows **Total** and **Custom** roles. Create a role, name it, and set its permissions.

### The Permission Matrix
Permissions are grouped by scope (Core POS, Accounting, Dala, Signature and more) and by action: **CREATE**, **READ**, **UPDATE**, **DELETE**, and special actions. Use **Search permissions** and the **All Scopes / All Actions** filters. Tick what the role should be able to do. Pages a user cannot access show *You don't have permission to access*, with a prompt to contact an administrator.

## Departments
**Departments** organise people across the whole business: department name, **short code**, **parent department**, head, **associated roles** and colour. Open a department to see its **members**, **targets**, **budgets** and sub-departments.

## Best practice
- Start from the least access and add as needed.
- Create separate roles for cashier, waiter, manager and accountant.
- Review roles whenever your team changes.

admin.title: Document Center
admin.description: Store folders, invoices, cheques, contracts and more, with AI search
admin.content:
# Document Center

**Document Center** manages your business documents in one place. Open it from the admin menu or the module menus.

## Tabs
- **All Documents**
- **Folders**
- **Cheques**
- **Invoices**

## Add a document
Click **New Document** (or **New Folder**) and fill in:
- **Name** and **Document Type**: Folder, Cheque, Invoice, Quotation, Receipt, Purchase Order, Delivery Note, Credit Note, Contract or Other.
- **Status**: Draft, Active, Archived or Cancelled.
- **Description**, counterparty (client or vendor, phone and email), reference number.
- **Financial details**: issue date, due date, payment terms, subtotal, amount paid, currency and balance.
- **Cheque details**: cheque number, bank, drawer, payee, amount and cheque date. Cheque status: Received, Pending, Processed or Bounced.
- **Attachments**: drag and drop PDFs, images, Word or Excel files.

Invoice-type documents track payment: Sent, Approved, Rejected, Paid, Partial or Overdue, with aging buckets such as *Overdue*, *Current (1-30 days)* and *Upcoming (31+ days)*.

## AI search
Turn on **AI Search** to find documents by what is inside them (extracted content), not only by name. If AI search is unavailable the page tells you and falls back to normal search.

## Open a document
View the details, attachments and **extracted content**. Edit or delete with confirmation.

## Use in conversations
In the Mteja inbox, search your documents by content and share a suggested file with a customer.

## Tips
- Use folders per customer, supplier or year.
- Mark settled invoices as Paid and archive old documents.

admin.title: E-Signature
admin.description: Upload a document, place signature fields and collect signatures online
admin.content:
# E-Signature

**E-Signature** lets you sign documents yourself or send them to others to sign.

## Upload a document
Click **Upload Document** and drop a **PDF, PNG, JPG or JPEG** (up to 50 MB). Base processes and verifies it, then opens it.

## The documents list
Cards or list view show each document's status: **Draft**, **Pending Signature**, **Partially Signed**, **Signed** or **Declined**. Search and filter by status. Totals appear at the top.

## Place fields and sign
Open a document. Click on the page to place:
- **Signature** (required or optional)
- **Initials**
- **Company Stamp**
- Date and other fields

Drag to move, copy to another page or duplicate to other pages, and delete when needed.

### Create a signature
**Add New** then choose:
- **Draw** with the mouse or finger
- **Type** your name in styles such as Script, Elegant, Print or Handwritten
- **Upload** an image (for stamps, a PNG with a transparent background works best)

Choose to **apply to the document**, **save to the library only**, or both. The **Signature Library** and **Stamp Library** let you reuse them.

## Workflows
Click **Initiate** and choose:
- **Self-sign (I will sign)**, or
- **Send for signing (Multiple signers)**: add signers with names and emails.

## Share a signing link
Create a **public signing link**. It expires in 24 hours; you can **Regenerate** or **Revoke** it. The signer opens the link, types their name (and email, optionally), adds their signature or stamp, and chooses **Finish signing**.

## After signing
**Download** the signed copy, or **Share via email**. A signed document shows *Document Signed*. To redo it use **Re-sign** or **Clear & Re-sign**.

## Permissions
Access is controlled by the *Signature* scope in Role Settings.

admin.title: Business Health Score
admin.description: A 75-point diagnostic of how your business is performing
admin.content:
# Business Health Score

Open **Business Health** in the admin menu for a diagnostic of your whole business, computed from your live data.

## What it measures
A comprehensive **75-point audit** across **six business dimensions**. It combines data from Duka transactions, the Pesa general ledger and aging, and Bandu/Mteja workforce, payroll and CRM data. The page shows what data was available and marks anything estimated as **Imputed**.

## What you see
- **Overall Business Health** score and band.
- **Performance across 6 dimensions**.
- **Key Business Strengths** and **Priority Areas for Improvement**.
- Detailed measures per dimension with the calculated value, score, weight and impact.
- **Branch** health scores, share of revenue and growth trend.
- **Aging ledgers** and **supplier traceability**.
- **Data Coverage & Diagnostics**: which services responded and how many records were read.

## Recalculate
Click **Recalculate Audit** after you make changes. It takes a short while, and a progress screen shows while it runs. If the diagnostic is unavailable, use **Retry Diagnostic**.

## How to use it
- Start with the **Priority Areas**.
- Fix data gaps first (missing costs, unposted entries) since they lower accuracy.
- Re-run monthly and watch the trend.

admin.title: Biashara AI Assistant
admin.description: Ask questions about sales, stock and growth and get an executive brief
admin.content:
# Biashara AI Assistant

**Biashara AI** is an in-app business advisor. Open it from the chat button in the admin area.

## What you can ask
Use the quick prompts, or type your own question:
- **Stock Alert Check**: which items are low or out of stock.
- **Top Velocity Item**: what is selling fastest.
- **Margin & Growth Tip**: ideas to improve profit and growth.

While it works you will see steps such as scanning branch feeds and cross-referencing analytics, and then it gives a short executive brief.

## Business stage
Choose the stage so advice fits: **Auto (Smart Detect)**, **Early Stage**, **Growth Stage** or **Mature Stage**.

## Tools
- **Regenerate** a response or **Retry** a prompt.
- **Export as PDF** to save the brief.
- **Listen** to a response (sound must be available).
- **Clear conversation** to start fresh (with confirmation).

## Tips
- Be specific: include the branch or period.
- Always check important figures in the reports before acting.

admin.title: Notifications
admin.description: Stay on top of bookings, stock alerts and system messages
admin.content:
# Notifications

Open **Notifications** from the bell in the top bar.

## What you get
- **New Booking / New Appointment**
- **Out of Stock** and **Low Inventory**
- **System** notifications from Base

## Two tabs
- **My Notifications**
- **System Notifications**

## Manage them
- Filter by **type**, **priority** (Medium, High, Urgent) and **status** (read or unread).
- Open a notification for the full **message**, when it was received, extra info and expiry.
- **Mark as Read**, **Mark All as Read** or **Delete**.
- **Reset Filters** to show everything.

## Tip
Treat **Out of Stock** alerts as a reorder trigger and check **Urgent** items first each morning.

admin.title: Website Builder & FAQs
admin.description: Manage your gallery images and your customer FAQs
admin.content:
# Website Builder & FAQs

## Website Builder
Open **Website Builder** to build a web presence for your business.
- **Gallery:** upload images, search them by name, title or description, filter by type (**Products, Store, Banners, Logos, Social Media, Other**), preview, edit and delete.
- Other sections (**Home Page** builder, **Product Management**, **Contact Page**, **About Page**) are marked **Coming soon**.

## FAQs
Open **FAQs** to manage the questions you want customers to see.
- **Add Category** to group FAQs.
- **Add FAQ** with a question, category and answer.
- Delete a category to remove all its FAQs (you are asked to confirm).
- **FAQ Details** shows the full entry.

## Tip
Keep gallery images in the correct type so they are easy to find later.

reports.title: Reports & Analytics Overview
reports.description: Where to find reports for every module and how to use them
reports.content:
# Reports & Analytics Overview

Open **Reports** (from the Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala or admin menus). The page has one tab per enabled module:

| Tab | Reports |
|---|---|
| **Duka (Store)** | Item Sales, Sales, Voided Bills, Delivery, Inventory Usage, VAT Summary, Top Sellers, Top Earners, Staff Hours |
| **Pesa (Accounting)** | Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, General Ledger, Account Balances, VAT, Cash Flow, statements, AR/AP Aging |
| **Mteja (CRM)** | Customer Master List, Lead Pipeline, Campaign Performance, Sales Target vs Actual, Visits, Lead Activity |
| **Dala (Real Estate)** | Portfolio, Sales, Payment Plans Due, Commissions Due, Rent Collection, Maintenance |
| **Bandu (HR)** | Employee Master List, Payroll Register, Leave Balance, Leave History, Department Staffing, Contact Directory |

## Common controls
- **Date & Time Range** (Today, This Week, This Month, This Quarter, This Year, Last Year, or Custom).
- **Branch** (or All Branches) where available.
- Other filters such as category, staff, status or department.
- Click the **Generate** button for the report.

## Output
- **Export** to CSV, Excel or PDF, or **Print**.
- Some reports offer **Thermal** or **A4 PDF** layouts.
- **Send Report** by email with a recipient, optional CC and a personal message.

## Permissions
If you see *You don't have permission to generate the report*, ask an admin to grant the report permission in Role Settings.

## Dashboards
The dashboards give quick totals for the period you pick; use reports when you need detail and exports.

reports.title: Sales Performance Reports
reports.description: Item sales, sales by payment method, top sellers and top earners
reports.content:
# Sales Performance Reports

All of these are in **Reports > Duka (Store)**.

## Item Sales Report
Shows each product or service sold in the period with **quantity**, **unit price**, **total**, **stock cost**, **gross profit** and **margin**. Group by period, and filter by category, main category, and who served. The header shows **Period Total**, **Stock Cost** and **Profit**.

## Sales Report
Shows total sales, **discounts**, and **sales by payment method** and by category/product, so you can match cash and M-Pesa to your till and bank.

## Top Sellers Report
Analyses your best-performing items:
- **Top 10 / 20 / 50 / 100** by **revenue**, **profit** or **profit margin**.
- Charts: **Top 10 Items by Revenue**, **Revenue by Category**, **Quantity vs Revenue**, **Profit Margin Analysis**.
- Per item: rank, margin, transactions and **stock status**.
- A **hierarchy** view groups sellers by category.

## Top Earners Report
Ranks staff by the revenue they earn, with total staff earnings and the platform cut. Useful for commission and incentives. You can exclude admin users from the PDF.

## Using the results
- Compare **margin**, not just revenue, before promoting an item.
- Match the payment-method totals to bank and M-Pesa statements.
- Drop or reprice items with low margin and low volume.

reports.title: Inventory & Operations Reports
reports.description: Inventory usage, deliveries, voided bills, VAT and staff hours
reports.content:
# Inventory & Operations Reports

These live in **Reports > Duka (Store)**.

## Inventory Usage Report
Shows the items used in the period: **item name**, **quantity** and the number of unique items. Choose **Inventory** or **Services**, and optionally a specific item.

## Delivery Report
Lists deliveries with total cost, total items, unit price and line totals. Preview as **Thermal** or **A4 PDF**.

## Voided Bills Report
Lists bills that were voided in the period with the voided categories and prices. Review it regularly to spot unusual voiding.

## VAT Summary Report
Shows **VAT configuration**, **total VAT collected**, subtotal, invoice count, **average VAT per invoice**, VAT as a percentage of revenue, and a breakdown by VAT type and pricing mode.

## Staff Hours Worked Report
For each employee: **total hours worked**, **completed sessions**, **open sessions**, first clock-in and last activity. Export to Excel or PDF.

## Stock checks on the Inventory page
The Inventory page itself has **Low Stock** and stock-state filters, and the dashboard flags depleted items.

## Tips
- Run the voided bills and inventory usage reports weekly.
- Reconcile VAT before filing each return.

reports.title: HR & Payroll Reports
reports.description: Employee, payroll, leave and staffing reports
reports.content:
# HR & Payroll Reports

Open **Reports > Bandu (HR)**. Choose the report, its filters and click **Generate**.

| Report | Shows |
|---|---|
| **Employee Master List** | ID, name, email, phone, department, position, employment type and hire date |
| **Payroll Register** | Period, gross pay, PAYE, NSSF, Housing Levy, NITA, net pay and payment method |
| **Leave Balance** | Entitlement, used and remaining by leave type |
| **Leave History** | Requests with type, dates, status and approver |
| **Department Staffing** | Staff counts, active/inactive and total salary per department |
| **Employee Contact Directory** | Phone, email and emergency contact |

## Filters
Department, employment status and type (Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Consultant), status (Processed, Pending Approval), employee, and date range.

## Dashboard
The **HR & Payroll Dashboard** shows total, active, suspended and terminated employees, attendance overview (present, absent, late, on leave) and leave status.

## Export
**Export Excel** or **Export PDF**. For payslips and P9 forms, use **Payslips** (see *Managing Wages & Payroll*).

onboarding.title: Quick Start Guide
onboarding.description: From first login to your first sale, in the right order
onboarding.content:
# Quick Start Guide

Base Point is a suite of connected modules: **Duka** (POS and inventory), **Pesa** (accounting), **Mteja** (CRM and messaging), **Bandu** (HR and payroll) and **Dala** (property). This guide gets a new business from first login to a first sale.

## 1. Sign in
1. Open the app in your browser, or install the Windows app (see *Installing the Windows App*).
2. Enter your **Company Code**, **Business Email** and **Password**.
3. If you work for more than one business, use **Switch Company** to change the company code.

Depending on how your account is set up you may also be asked for an authenticator code or an email one-time code.

## 2. Add your business details
Open **Settings** (admin menu) and complete:
- **Basic Info**: business name, email and phone.
- **VAT Config**: turn VAT on or off, choose Tax Inclusive or Tax Exclusive pricing and set the standard rate.
- **Logo & Branding**: upload your logo and pick the colour scheme used across the app and on documents.

## 3. Turn on the modules you need
Go to **Discover** and enable only what you will use (Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala, plus add-ons such as eTIMS, Asset Manager and Pesapal). The sidebar changes to match the modules that are on.

## 4. Create your branches
In **Branch Management**, add each location and choose its **POS Mode** (Duka Services, Retail, Hospital or Hotel). See *Managing Shops & Branches*.

## 5. Set up the catalogue
- Create **Categories** (main category, then sub-category).
- Add products and services in **Inventory** (or bulk-import them from Excel).
- Add **Payment Methods** and, for restaurants, **Tables**.

## 6. Add your team
Create users in **Crew Management**, give each a role, and review the role's permissions in **Role Settings**.

## 7. Make your first sale
Open the POS (**Tables** for restaurants, or the POS screen for retail), add items, take payment and print the receipt.

## What next?
- Read the module guides for the areas you enabled.
- Check the dashboard daily, and the **Reports** page weekly.
- Use the live chat in the app if you get stuck.

onboarding.title: Account Setup
onboarding.description: Sign-in options, your profile, security and business settings
onboarding.content:
# Account Setup

## Signing in
The sign-in screen asks for:
- **Company Code**: identifies your business.
- **Business Email** and **Password**.

Use **Switch Company** if you need to sign in to a different business.

## Your profile
Open your profile from the user menu to update your details and manage how you sign in.

### Sign-in methods
You can choose how you authenticate:
- **Email and password**.
- **Authenticator app** (two-factor authentication).
- **Email one-time password**.
- **Quick 4-digit PIN access** for fast sign-in on a shared device.

Use **Switch Authentication Method** to change it.

### Changing your password
Passwords must be at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number. A special character is optional. The strength meter shows how strong your choice is.

### Setting up two-factor authentication
1. Choose **Generate QR Code**.
2. Scan the code with an authenticator app on your phone.
3. Enter the 6-digit code to **Verify and Enable**.
4. **Download your backup codes** and keep them somewhere safe. You need them if you lose your phone.

You can later **Disable 2FA** or **Regenerate Backup Codes** from the same place.

## Business settings
Admins configure the business under **Settings**:
- **Basic Info**: name, email, phone.
- **VAT Config**: VAT status, pricing mode, standard rate.
- **Logo & Branding**: logo and colour scheme.

Branch-level details such as the business profile, receipt layout and printers are under **System Setup** (see *System Settings & Configuration*).

onboarding.title: Module Activation Guide
onboarding.description: Turn Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala and add-ons on or off
onboarding.content:
# Module Activation Guide

All modules are managed from one place: **Discover** (open it from the admin menu).

## How to enable a module
1. Go to **Discover**.
2. Open the module card and review its **Features** and **Benefits**.
3. Click **Enable**.
4. Accept the agreement. For paid add-ons you are asked to acknowledge that additional charges may apply.
5. The app applies the change and reloads. The sidebar then shows the new module.

To turn a module off, open its card and choose **Disable**. You are asked to confirm first.

## What is available
| Module | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Duka by Base** | Point of sale, inventory, customers, orders, shifts and reports |
| **Pesa by Base** | Accounting that syncs with your POS (journals, bills, banking, reports) |
| **Mteja by Base** | CRM: leads, campaigns, conversations and messaging |
| **Bandu by Base** | HR: employees, attendance, leave and payroll |
| **Dala by Base** | Property: portfolios, leases, rent, sales and commissions |
| **eTIMS** | KRA electronic tax invoicing |
| **Asset Manager** | Fixed asset register, requests and maintenance |
| **Pesapal** | Online card and mobile money payments (needs your merchant keys) |

Some entries are marked **Coming Soon**. Those cannot be enabled yet.

## Configuration notes
- **Pesa**: when you enable it with Duka, you can configure **Auto Sync** and the **Sync Interval**.
- **Pesapal**: enter the **Consumer Key**, **Consumer Secret** and choose the **Environment** (sandbox or live).
- **eTIMS**: billing applies. See *Etims Integration Guide*.

## Pricing
Pricing is not shown on the card. Choose **Contact support for pricing** to get a quote for the modules you want.

## Tips
- Enable only what you need so your team sees a simpler menu.
- Disabling a module hides it; talk to support before disabling one that holds live data.

onboarding.title: Data Import Guide
onboarding.description: Bring products, customers, leads and employees in from Excel
onboarding.content:
# Data Import Guide

Base Point imports data from Excel files. There is no single import screen: each list has its own **Import** button, so you import from the page where that data lives.

## What you can import
| Data | Where to import |
|---|---|
| Inventory items | **Inventory > Bulk Import** |
| Customers | **Customers > Import** |
| Leads | **Leads > Import Leads** |
| Employees | **Bandu > Employees > Import** |
| Bank statements | **Banking > Import Statement** (CSV, Excel or PDF) |

## The import steps
1. Click the import button and choose **Template** to download a ready-made Excel template (if you don't have one yet).
2. Fill in your data. Keep the header row.
3. Upload the file. Choose the **Sheet** and confirm the **Header at row** value.
4. Check the **Column mapping**. Base Point matches your columns to its fields. Fix any marked **Missing**.
5. Review the **Data preview**.
6. Run the import. The summary shows how many rows were **Created**, **Updated** and **Skipped**.

## Inventory-specific options
- Tick **Update existing products (don't create duplicates)** to update items you already have.
- Missing **units, categories and suppliers** are created automatically while importing.

## Leads and customers
- When importing leads you can **Assign leads to staff** in one go.
- Phone numbers and emails are validated. Rows with errors are skipped and listed.

## If rows are skipped
Fix the rows listed in the error summary and re-upload only those rows. Use **Import Another** to start again.

## Best practices
- Import a small sample first to check the mapping.
- Keep your original file.
- Import in batches for very large lists.
- Check totals after importing (for example the stock value on the inventory page).

onboarding.title: Installing the Windows App
onboarding.description: Download the desktop app and open Base from your computer
onboarding.content:
# Installing the Windows App

Base is available as a Windows desktop app as well as in the browser.

## Download
1. On the sign-in screen choose **Download for Windows** (or **Get the app**).
2. On the download page, choose the **MSI installer**. If the download does not start, use **All releases** to pick a version.
3. Run the installer.

## Open it
- After installing, use **Open in app** from the sign-in or download page, or launch Base from the Start menu.
- Sign in with your usual Company Code, email and password.

## Why use the desktop app?
- Opens straight into Base without browser tabs.
- Works well on the till computer where receipts are printed.
- Pairs with the **Print Agent** for direct receipt and kitchen printing (see *Printing Setup*).

## Browser or app?
Both give you the same data. Use whichever suits each device. Phones and tablets use the browser.

billing.title: Subscription Plans
billing.description: How access, modules and pricing work today
billing.content:
# Subscription Plans

## How pricing works
Base Point is sold as a set of modules (Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala) plus add-ons (eTIMS, Asset Manager, Pesapal). Pricing depends on the modules and locations you use, so it is quoted for your business.

- Open **Discover** and choose **Contact support for pricing** on any module to get a quote.
- Some add-ons (for example eTIMS) tell you that **billing will apply** before you turn them on.

## Your plan details
Your business record shows its status (Active, Pending Approval, Suspended or Terminated), the business type and size, and the **next billing** date. Admins can see this under **Settings**.

## Changing what you pay for
- To add a module, enable it from **Discover**.
- To remove one, disable it from **Discover**.
- For plan questions, contact support through the in-app chat.

## The Billing page
The **Billing** page in the admin menu is being built. It is set to cover unified billing across all your locations, plan changes, and payment history. Until it is released, use the in-app chat for billing questions. You can ask to be notified when it is ready.

billing.title: Payment Methods
billing.description: Set up how your customers pay you: cash, M-Pesa, bank, Pesapal
billing.content:
# Payment Methods

This article is about the ways **your customers pay you**. (For your own Base subscription, see *Subscription Plans*.)

## Where to configure
Open **Payment Methods** (Duka menu or admin menu). It has two parts:
- **Payment Methods**: the options cashiers see at checkout, for example Cash, M-Pesa, Card, Bank Transfer and Cheque.
- **Payment Details**: the account information printed on invoices, such as **Paybill / Business No.**, **Account No.** and bank details.

## Add a payment method
1. Open **Payment Methods** and choose to add a new method.
2. Enter the name, for example *M-Pesa*.
3. Save. It now appears on the payment screen at the POS.

Edit or delete a method from the **Actions** column. Deleting asks you to confirm.

## Add M-Pesa or bank details
Under **System Setup > Payment Methods** you can add:
- **M-Pesa payment details**: select the payment method, then enter the **Business No.** and **Account No.**.
- **Bank details**: pick a bank to auto-fill its name and paybill number, then add the account details.

These details print on invoices so customers know where to pay.

## Online payments with Pesapal
Enable **Pesapal** in **Discover** and enter your merchant **Consumer Key**, **Consumer Secret** and environment. Customers can then pay online by card or mobile money.

## M-Pesa STK Push at the POS
At checkout choose M-Pesa, enter the customer's Kenyan number (for example 0712345678) and send an **STK Push**. The customer enters their PIN on their phone and the sale completes once payment is confirmed.

billing.title: Understanding Your Bill
billing.description: What can affect what you pay and how to get a clear answer
billing.content:
# Understanding Your Bill

## What drives your charges
Your charges are based on what is enabled for your business:
- The **modules** you turned on in **Discover**.
- **Add-ons** such as eTIMS and Asset Manager, which show a billing notice when you enable them.
- The size of your setup (for example number of branches), as agreed with Base.

## Checking what is active
1. Open **Discover**. Modules marked **Enabled** are the ones in use.
2. Open **Branch Management** to see how many branches you have.
3. Under **Settings**, check your business status and **Next Billing** date.

## Taxes
Pricing for your own customers (VAT on invoices and receipts) is separate. VAT is configured under **Settings > VAT Config**. See *VAT Compliance & Reporting*.

## Questions or corrections
- Use the in-app chat and describe what you expected versus what you were charged.
- Include the module or branch name so it can be checked quickly.

## Coming soon
A full **Billing** page with payment history and plan management is planned. Until then, billing support is handled through support.

faq.title: Common Issues
faq.description: Quick fixes for sign-in, POS, printing, payments and reports
faq.content:
# Common Issues

## Signing in
- **Wrong company or email**: check the **Company Code**. Use **Switch Company** if you work for several businesses.
- **Authenticator code not accepted**: make sure your phone time is correct. Use a **backup code** if you lost the phone.
- **Account suspended or terminated**: ask an admin to reactivate or reinstate you in **Crew Management**.
- **"You don't have permission to access"**: your role does not allow that page. Ask an admin to update your role in **Role Settings**.

## POS and orders
- **Products not appearing at the POS**: check the product is in a category that has **Show on POS** turned on, and that it is active.
- **Table is unavailable**: it is being served by another staff member. Ask them to release it or ask an admin.
- **Cannot reduce a sent item**: only a cashier or admin can reduce the quantity of an item already sent to the kitchen.
- **Internet is down**: keep selling. Orders are saved on the device and sync automatically (see *Working Offline*).

## Payments
- **M-Pesa STK Push not arriving**: confirm a valid Kenyan number such as 0712345678 and that the phone has network.
- **Payment status unknown**: wait a moment, then check the order's payment history before retrying so you do not charge twice.

## Printing
- **Receipt not printing**: open **System Setup > Printers**. The printer should show **Online**. Use **Test Print**. See *Printing Setup*.

## Tax (eTIMS)
- **ETR shows Failed or In Flight**: open the invoice and use **Refresh ETR Status** or **Verify with KRA**. Make sure the shop's **KRA PIN** is set.

## Reports and totals
- **Report is empty**: check the **date range** and **branch** filters.
- **Totals differ from the dashboard**: dashboards follow the period filter at the top (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom).

## Still stuck?
Use the in-app chat and include the page name, what you clicked and any error message you saw.

faq.title: Contact Support
faq.description: How to reach us and what to include so we can help faster
faq.content:
# Contact Support

## Live chat
The quickest route is the **live chat** inside the app. Open it from any page and describe your question.

## Help Center
Search this Help Center first. Each module has its own section with step-by-step guides.

## Help your request move faster
Please include:
- Your **business name and Company Code**.
- The **branch** and **module** (for example Duka, Pesa, Mteja).
- The **page** you were on and exactly what you clicked.
- The **error message** or a screenshot.
- For payments or invoices: the **order, invoice or receipt number**.

## Billing and module pricing
Use **Discover** and choose **Contact support for pricing** on a module, or ask in the chat.

## Feature requests
Tell us what you tried to do and what was missing. We use this to plan new features.

## Legal and privacy
For terms and privacy matters, see the **Terms and Conditions** and **Privacy Policy** linked on the sign-in page.

faq.title: Security Best Practices
faq.description: Protect your business data with roles, strong sign-in and good habits
faq.content:
# Security Best Practices

## Strong sign-in
- Use a password of 8+ characters with upper-case, lower-case and a number.
- Turn on **two-factor authentication** in your profile (authenticator app) and store the **backup codes** safely.
- Use **Quick 4-digit PIN access** only on trusted, shared devices.
- Never share one login between staff.

## Roles and permissions
Each user has a role. In **Role Settings** the **Permission Matrix** lets you control, per area, who can **Create**, **Read**, **Update** and **Delete**. Areas include Core (POS), Accounting, Dala and Signature.
- Give people only what they need.
- Review roles when someone changes job.
- Keep admin accounts to a minimum. Admin users cannot be deleted.

## Managing staff access
In **Crew Management** you can:
- **Suspend** a user (they cannot log in until reactivated).
- **Terminate** a user (blocks all login access; can be reinstated later).
- **Delete** a user who should be removed completely.

Remove or suspend ex-employees the same day they leave.

## Controlling printing
In **System Setup > Printing Controls** you can limit how many times a document can be printed, require a **reason for reprints**, and require **admin approval** for reprints. Use these for receipts and invoices that must not be duplicated.

## Print only after payment
In the privacy settings you can stop cashiers printing a customer's bill until the order has been paid for.

## Phishing and devices
- Only sign in at the official Base address or the installed app.
- Do not share OTP or backup codes with anyone, including people claiming to be support.
- Lock shared computers when you leave them.

faq.title: Performance Optimization
faq.description: Keep the app fast on slow connections and busy tills
faq.content:
# Performance Optimization

## Network
- Prefer a stable connection (wired where possible) on the till computer.
- When the connection drops, the POS shows an **Offline** indicator and keeps working. See *Working Offline*.
- Large exports and reports are quicker on a good connection.

## Browser and device
- Use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or install the **Windows app**.
- Close unused tabs, and restart the browser if the app feels slow after a long day.
- If screens look outdated after an update, refresh the page.

## Keep data lean
- Use the **date range** filters on reports and lists rather than loading everything.
- Archive or delete test data you no longer need.
- Use **Branch** filters on multi-branch dashboards to focus the data.

## Dashboards
Dashboards and reports follow the period you pick (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom). A shorter period loads faster.

## When to contact support
- Pages stay slow on several devices and networks.
- You see repeated timeouts or errors.
- Only one branch or module is affected.

Include the page name and the time it happened.
